title: Especial de Navidad
subtitle: Homero se ve obligado a convertirse en el Santa Claus de los grandes almacenes cuando Marge gasta los ahorros navideños de la familia en eliminar el tatuaje de Bart.

title: Bart es un genio
subtitle: Bart termina en una escuela para niños superdotados después de hacer trampa en una prueba de coeficiente intelectual.

title: La odisea de Homero
subtitle: Después de perder su trabajo, Homero contempla poner fin a todo, hasta que descubre un nuevo camino en la vida como defensor de la seguridad.

title: Una familia modelo
subtitle: Después de ser avergonzado por el resto de la familia en un picnic de la empresa, Homero se obsesiona con mejorar su comportamiento mutuo.

title: Bart el General
subtitle: Después de haber sido golpeado por Nelson Muntz demasiadas veces, Bart pide ayuda al abuelo y pronto lidera una rebelión contra el matón de la escuela.

title: La Depresion De Lisa
subtitle: El espíritu de Lisa deprimida, se levanta cuando conoce a un músico de jazz, Bleeding Gums Murphy.

title: La llamada de los Simpson
subtitle: Homero lleva a la familia a acampar, pero pronto todo se convierte en una desventura cuando pierden su equipo y lo confunden con Pie Grande.

title: El Heroe Sin Cabeza
subtitle: Bart obtiene más de lo que esperaba cuando corta la cabeza de una estatua del fundador de la ciudad.

title: Un Momento De Decision
subtitle: Después de que Homero humilla a Marge en su cumpleaños, ella comienza a jugar a los bolos por despecho, solo para desarrollar un enamoramiento mutuo con un amable instructor de francés.

title: La Correria De Homero
subtitle: Después de que una fotografía de Homero girando con una bailarina exótica se distribuye por todo Springfield, Marge lo echa de la casa.

title: Intercambio Cultural
subtitle: Bart es enviado a Francia en un programa de intercambio de estudiantes, donde lo tratan como a un esclavo; Un estudiante albanés con motivos sospechosos ocupa el lugar de Bart en la familia.

title: Krusty va a la carcel
subtitle: Después de que Krusty es declarado culpable de robar el Kwik-E-Mart tras el testimonio de Homero, Bart y Lisa se propusieron a demostrar su inocencia.

title: Una Noche Encantadora
subtitle: Homero lleva a Marge a pasar una noche en la ciudad para compensar su reciente descuido hacia ella, dejando a los niños con una niñera siniestra que tiene un secreto diabólico.

title: Bart Gets an F
subtitle: Mrs. Krabappel, fed up with Bart's lackadaisical approach to his studies, gives him an ultimatum: shape up or repeat the fourth grade.

title: Simpson and Delilah
subtitle: Homer lies on a medical insurance form in order to obtain a miracle hair restoring drug.

title: Treehouse of Horror
subtitle: The Simpsons move into a cursed house, then are abducted by aliens, before Homer is ensconced in a tale by Edgar Allen Poe.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
subtitle: After the power plant experiences bad publicity and is threatened with closure, Mr. Burns decides to run for Governor in order to have power over the law.

title: Dancin' Homer
subtitle: Homer's heckling of the Springfield Isotopes baseball team during one of their games inadvertently leads to his appointment as the new team mascot.

title: Dead Putting Society
subtitle: In an attempt to show up Ned Flanders, Homer pits Bart against Ned's son, Todd, in a miniature golf competition.

title: Bart vs. Thanksgiving
subtitle: On Thanksgiving, Bart runs away after refusing to apologize to a distraught Lisa for accidentally destroying her cornucopia.

title: Bart the Daredevil
subtitle: After seeing a motorcycle daredevil at a monster truck show, Bart becomes a death-defying daredevil skateboarder.

title: Itchy & Scratchy & Marge
subtitle: Marge becomes a crusader against cartoon violence after an episode of "Itchy and Scratchy" seemingly inspires Maggie to attack Homer.

title: Bart Gets Hit by a Car
subtitle: After Bart gets hit by a car driven by Mr. Burns, Homer is manipulated by ambulance-chaser Lionel Hutz into bringing an outrageous lawsuit against his boss.

title: One Fish, Two Fish, Blowfish, Blue Fish
subtitle: After apparently consuming poison blowfish, Homer is told that he only has 24 hours to live and sets to tie up all the loose threads in his life in one day.

title: The Way We Was
subtitle: Homer and Marge tell the story of how they met and fell in love in high school.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
subtitle: Homer gets a crooked cable guy to install free cable in the Simpson home, and as a result, Lisa faces an ethical crisis over her family's stealing.

title: Principal Charming
subtitle: Homer tries to set Selma up with Principal Skinner, only for him to fall for Patty instead.

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
subtitle: Homer meets his half-brother Herb Powell, an automobile tycoon who zealously bonds with the family and tasks Homer with designing a car for the average American.

title: Bart's Dog Gets an F
subtitle: After an uncontrollable Santa's Little Helper destroys several important Simpson possessions, Homer announces that he will be thrown out of the house unless he completes obedience training.

title: Old Money
subtitle: After Grampa's new girlfriend dies and leaves him $106,000 in her will, he tries to decide what to do with it.

title: Brush with Greatness
subtitle: After rekindling her artistic talents, Marge is commissioned to paint a portrait of Mr. Burns; Homer vows to lose weight after getting trapped in a water slide.

title: Lisa's Substitute
subtitle: Lisa has a crush on her substitute teacher; Bart decides to run for class president.

title: The War of the Simpsons
subtitle: Homer must decide whether he should complete marriage counseling or skip out to catch a legendary catfish; Bart and Lisa take advantage of Grampa's ignorance of the house rules.

title: Three Men and a Comic Book
subtitle: Bart, Milhouse and Martin each pitch in to buy an highly-collectible "Radioactive Man" comic book, which soon has a disastrous effect on their friendship.

title: Blood Feud
subtitle: After Bart saves Mr. Burns' life with a donated blood transfusion, Homer vows revenge when they receive only a "thank you" card as compensation.

title: Stark Raving Dad
subtitle: Homer accidentally lands in a mental hospital and ends up sharing a room with a white man who thinks he is Michael Jackson.

title: Mr. Lisa Goes to Washington
subtitle: After winning a political essay contest, Lisa is invited to Washington, D.C., but she soon becomes upset after discovering how policy-making really works.

title: When Flanders Failed
subtitle: After wishing for Flanders to lose his business, Homer discovers that his neighbor is actually about to go bankrupt and decides to help him out.

title: Bart the Murderer
subtitle: After having a horrible day, Bart gets a job tending bar for a group of gangsters and becomes the prime suspect when Principal Skinner mysteriously disappears.

title: Homer Defined
subtitle: Homer is a hero after averting a nuclear meltdown that he nearly caused, but he doesn't want to tell anyone that he stopped it completely by accident.

title: Like Father, Like Clown
subtitle: After learning that Krusty is Jewish, Bart and Lisa seek to help him reconcile his faith and career by reuniting him with his estranged rabbi father.

title: Treehouse of Horror II
subtitle: The Simpsons receive a wish-granting monkey's paw, Bart gains magical powers which he uses to turn Homer into a Jack-in-the-box, and Mr. Burns uses Homer's brain to create a robot.

title: Lisa's Pony
subtitle: Homer buys Lisa a pony that the family can ill afford.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
subtitle: After Homer fails a fathering test, he decides to help Bart build his Soap Box Derby racer.

title: Flaming Moe's
subtitle: Moe claims a drink that Homer invented is his own, with the drink making the bar a local hot spot, but threatens his friendship with Homer.

title: Burns Verkaufen der Kraftwerk
subtitle: Mr. Burns decides to retire and sells the power plant to a German consortium, which lays off Homer after his laziness and inefficiency are quickly exposed.

title: I Married Marge
subtitle: As Marge goes to the doctor for a pregnancy test, Homer tells the children of the events leading up to his marriage, and Bart's birth.

title: Radio Bart
subtitle: After Bart receives a microphone which can transmit through radios, he decides to pull a series of pranks and eventually convinces the town that a boy has fallen down a well.

title: Lisa the Greek
subtitle: Homer uses Lisa (and her prognostic skills) to help him bet on football games.

title: Homer Alone
subtitle: While Marge spends a couple of days at Rancho Relaxo after she has a breakdown, Bart and Lisa stay with Patty and Selma, and Homer stays at home to take care of Maggie.

title: Bart the Lover
subtitle: After Mrs. Krabappel gives Bart a month of detention, he gets his revenge by responding to her newspaper singles ad; Homer uses a swear jar to cut down on his cursing.

title: Homer at the Bat
subtitle: Homer and his co-workers qualify for the plant softball team's league final, but Mr. Burns hires nine professional MLB players in order to win a $1 million bet.

title: Separate Vocations
subtitle: After aptitude tests seemingly indicate that they are best-suited to police work and homemaking respectively, Bart is made hall monitor while Lisa becomes a delinquent.

title: Dog of Death
subtitle: After the Simpsons regret paying for an expensive surgery for Santa's Little Helper, he runs away from home and is trained by Mr. Burns to become an attack dog.

title: Colonel Homer
subtitle: Homer becomes the manager of a beautiful young country singer and finds himself almost attracted to her, sparking Marge's jealousy.

title: Black Widower
subtitle: Sideshow Bob gets out of jail and plots to take his revenge on Bart by marrying his Aunt Selma and killing her.

title: The Otto Show
subtitle: After Otto loses his job as school bus driver because he does not have a license, Bart convinces Homer and Marge to let Otto stay with them until he gets back on his feet.

title: Bart's Friend Falls in Love
subtitle: Bart becomes jealous when Milhouse falls in love with a new student named Samantha; Homer accidentally receives a vocabulary-building tape instead of a weight-loss one.

title: Brother, Can You Spare Two Dimes?
subtitle: After Homer "wins" a $2000 settlement from the plant due to radiation-induced sterilization, his half-brother Herb sees an opportunity to regain his fortune.

title: Kamp Krusty
subtitle: Bart and Lisa attend "Kamp Krusty" but it is nothing like they thought it would be; Homer's hair grows back and he loses weight while the kids are away.

title: A Streetcar Named Marge
subtitle: Marge stars in a musical adaptation of A Streetcar Named Desire, but is angry with Homer's lack of interest; Maggie squares off with her strict new daycare owner.

title: Homer the Heretic
subtitle: After attributing a relaxing Sunday to his skipping church, Homer vows to never attend service again, and forms his own religion to justify his behavior.

title: Lisa the Beauty Queen
subtitle: Homer enters Lisa in the Little Miss Springfield pageant to build her self-esteem.

title: Treehouse of Horror III
subtitle: An evil Krusty the Clown doll tries to kill Homer; Marge is captured by a giant ape who falls in love with her; Bart inadvertently raises the dead.

title: Itchy & Scratchy: The Movie
subtitle: With Bart continually getting in trouble, Homer bans him from seeing the new Itchy & Scratchy movie.

title: Marge Gets a Job
subtitle: When Marge takes a job at the power plant, Mr. Burns falls in love with her; Bart "cries wolf" to avoid taking a test.

title: New Kid on the Block
subtitle: Bart develops a crush on his new neighbor, only to discover that she's dating Jimbo Jones; Homer sues an all-you-can-eat restaurant after he's kicked out.

title: Mr. Plow
subtitle: Homer opens a successful snow-plowing business, only to inspire Barney to start a rival outfit that puts him out of work.

title: Lisa's First Word
subtitle: While trying to coax Maggie into saying her first word, Homer and Marge talk about how Lisa spoke hers.

title: Homer's Triple Bypass
subtitle: Years of poor eating habits catch up with Homer when he suffers a massive heart attack, but the family can't afford the triple bypass operation he needs.

title: Marge vs. the Monorail
subtitle: After receiving a considerable donation of money, Springfield builds a monorail system with Homer as the conductor, unaware they've just boarded a one-way train to Hell.

title: Selma's Choice
subtitle: Selma starts to feel broody, but after taking Bart and Lisa to Duff Gardens, she changes her mind.

title: Brother from the Same Planet
subtitle: When Bart gets tired of Homer's horrible parenting skills, he enrolls in the "Bigger Brother" program where he's assigned a fantastic role model.

title: I Love Lisa
subtitle: Lisa gives Ralph a Valentine's card out of pity, but soon regrets it when he develops an unwanted crush on her.

title: Duffless
subtitle: After Homer loses his license for DUI, Marge pressures him to give up beer for a month; Lisa attempts to prove that Bart is less intelligent than a hamster.

title: Last Exit to Springfield
subtitle: When Mr. Burns revokes the plant's dental plan, forcing Lisa to be fitted with cheap, ugly braces, Homer leads its union into going on strike.

title: So It's Come to This: A Simpsons Clip Show
subtitle: While Homer recovers in hospital from Bart's disastrous April Fool's Day prank, the family reminiscences over earlier hardships.

title: The Front
subtitle: Bart and Lisa convince Grampa to let them use his name for episodes of "Itchy and Scratchy" they have written; Homer re-takes a test he failed in high school.

title: Whacking Day
subtitle: Marge home-schools Bart after he is expelled from Springfield Elementary; Lisa protests a barbaric local holiday centered around clubbing snakes to death.

title: Marge in Chains
subtitle: A misunderstanding leads to Marge being imprisoned for shoplifting, with her absence soon descending the family, and eventually, the town into chaos.

title: Krusty Gets Kancelled
subtitle: When Krusty's show is canceled after losing viewers to a ventriloquist and his dummy, Bart and Lisa organize a celebrity-filled comeback special for their favorite clown.

title: Homer's Barbershop Quartet
subtitle: After the kids find a record with Homer's picture on it, he recalls the story of how he achieved fame in the 1980s with his barbershop quartet, The Be Sharps.

title: Cape Feare
subtitle: Sideshow Bob gets granted parole and the Simpsons enlist in witness protection, but Bob is hot on their tail and won't stop until he's even with Bart.

title: Homer Goes to College
subtitle: When a surprise inspection of the nuclear power plant reveals that Homer is not qualified to do his job, he is forced to go to college.

title: Rosebud
subtitle: After his birthday party goes wrong, Mr. Burns begins to want his childhood toy, a teddy bear named Bobo; Homer finds that Maggie is in possession of the doll.

title: Treehouse of Horror IV
subtitle: Homer sells his soul to the Devil for a donut, Bart contends with a gremlin on the side of the school bus which only he can see, and the family discovers that Mr. Burns is a vampire.

title: Marge on the Lam
subtitle: A girls' night out turns into a high speed chase when Marge learns her friend is driving a stolen car.

title: Bart's Inner Child
subtitle: Brad Goodman, a self-help guru, encourages Springfield to act more like Bart, with disastrous results.

title: Boy Scoutz 'n the Hood
subtitle: After joining the Junior Campers while on a sugar high, Bart reluctantly invites Homer to accompany him on the group's annual father-son rafting trip, which soon goes awry.

title: The Last Temptation of Homer
subtitle: Homer's marriage is in trouble when he develops an attraction to a new co-worker; Bart undergoes medical treatments that make him look like a nerd.

title: $pringfield (Or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
subtitle: Mr. Burns builds a casino when Springfield decides to legalize gambling, with Marge becoming addicted to the slot machines.

title: Homer the Vigilante
subtitle: Springfield is hit with multiple home invasions in only a couple nights, and after the Simpsons household is made a victim Homer fancies himself as a vigilante.

title: Bart Gets Famous
subtitle: Bart becomes an overnight sensation as the "I didn't do it" boy on Krusty the Clown's show.

title: Homer and Apu
subtitle: Apu moves in with the Simpsons after losing his job when Homer gets ill from the contaminated food; James Woods takes over the Kwik-E-Mart.

title: Lisa vs. Malibu Stacy
subtitle: Angered by the vacuous phrases her Malibu Stacy doll utters, Lisa works with Malibu Stacy's original designer to create a doll with admirable traits.

title: Deep Space Homer
subtitle: In an effort to increase the dismal television ratings for their space launches, NASA decides to send an ordinary man into space, and Homer is chosen for the task.

title: Homer Loves Flanders
subtitle: After Flanders invites Homer to a football game, the pair become friends, but Homer's possessiveness and loutish behaviour slowly turns Ned against him.

title: Bart Gets an Elephant
subtitle: After Bart receives an elephant as a prize for calling in to a radio station, the animal proves to be too costly to care for and Homer decides to sell it.

title: Burns' Heir
subtitle: After a close brush with death, Mr. Burns decides to find an heir to his empire, and chooses Bart because of his truly devious nature.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
subtitle: Bart accidentally gets Principal Skinner fired on inspection day, with Ned Flanders taking over as his replacement.

title: The Boy Who Knew Too Much
subtitle: Bart witnesses the alleged assault of a waiter by Mayor Quimby's nephew, but coming forward will mean admitting to skipping class and facing the consequences.

title: Lady Bouvier's Lover
subtitle: Grampa falls in love with Marge's mother, but must compete with Mr. Burns for her heart.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
subtitle: Homer begins teaching a class on how to have a successful marriage, but jeopardizes his own marriage by revealing secrets about himself and Marge.

title: Bart of Darkness
subtitle: Confined to his room with a broken leg, Bart suspects Ned Flanders of murdering Maude; the family's new swimming pool earns Lisa popularity among the neighborhood kids.

title: Lisa's Rival
subtitle: Lisa is jealous when a new girl in class is smarter than she is; Homer obtains a giant mound of sugar.

title: Another Simpsons Clip Show
subtitle: The family recalls past tales of lost love.

title: Itchy & Scratchy Land
subtitle: A family vacation to Itchy & Scratchy Land turns disastrous when the robots malfunction and turn on the tourists.

title: Sideshow Bob Roberts
subtitle: When Sideshow Bob is released from prison at the urging of a right-wing radio host and is elected Mayor of Springfield, Bart and Lisa are determined to expose his corruption.

title: Treehouse of Horror V
subtitle: The family's job at Mr. Burns' country estate goes awry when Homer goes mad; Homer's attempt to repair a toaster results in inadvertent time travel; The school staff turn cannibalistic.

title: Bart's Girlfriend
subtitle: Bart falls for Reverend Lovejoy's daughter and is surprised when she becomes a bad influence on him.

title: Lisa on Ice
subtitle: Sibling rivalry between Bart and Lisa ensues when they become the star players of their respective ice hockey teams.

title: Homer Badman
subtitle: Homer is branded as a pervert after his kids' babysitter misconstrues his retrieval of a candy from the seat of her pants as a sexual advance.

title: Grampa vs. Sexual Inadequacy
subtitle: Homer and Abe hit the road to sell Abe's miraculous aphrodisiac, but left in each other's company old wounds reopen.

title: Fear of Flying
subtitle: The Simpsons are about to go on vacation, but Marge panics on the airplane and demands to get off. After denying there's anything wrong to her family, then goes into therapy to find the root cause of her aerophobia.

title: Homer the Great
subtitle: Homer becomes a member of a mysterious organization called the Stonecutters and is heralded as "the chosen one".

title: And Maggie Makes Three
subtitle: Homer recounts the story of Maggie's birth when the kids ask why there are no photos of her in the family album.

title: Bart's Comet
subtitle: Bart discovers a comet that is on a collision course with Springfield.

title: Homie the Clown
subtitle: Homer becomes a Krusty the Clown stand-in, but is mistaken for the real Krusty by the Springfield mafia.

title: Bart vs. Australia
subtitle: After refusing to pay for a collect call, Bart must travel down under to repair US-Australian political relations, but is unprepared for the punishment awaiting him.

title: Homer vs. Patty and Selma
subtitle: Desperate for money, Homer takes a loan from Patty and Selma; Bart discovers a natural talent for ballet.

title: A Star Is Burns
subtitle: The citizens of Springfield host their own film festival, with popular movie critic Jay Sherman arriving from New York to judge.

title: Lisa's Wedding
subtitle: A fortune teller gives Lisa a look at her wedding in the year 2010.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
subtitle: Santa's Little Helper's new mate has puppies, and Mr. Burns schemes to steal them and make them into a coat.

title: The PTA Disbands
subtitle: Bart manipulates Mrs. Krabappel into leading a teachers' strike against Principal Skinner, but is perturbed when Marge becomes his substitute.

title: 'Round Springfield
subtitle: While Bart is hospitalized, Lisa runs into her old mentor Bleeding Gums Murphy, who is also a patient, and becomes devastated when he dies soon after.

title: The Springfield Connection
subtitle: Marge joins the Springfield Police Department to fight crime and corruption, only to find herself rescuing Homer when he gets mixed up in a counterfeit jeans operation.

title: Lemon of Troy
subtitle: When a group of Shelbyville kids steal Springfield's sacred lemon tree, Bart and his friends venture there to get the tree back.

title: Who Shot Mr. Burns? Part One
subtitle: After Mr. Burns steals oil from Springfield Elementary and blocks out the sun, an unknown person shoots him.

title: Who Shot Mr. Burns? Part Two
subtitle: While Mr. Burns is hospitalized, an investigation into his shooter begins; although Smithers initially suspects himself, a trace of Simpson DNA narrows down the list of possible culprits.

title: Radioactive Man
subtitle: A Hollywood film crew shoots an adaptation of the "Radioactive Man" comics in Springfield, with Rainier Wolfcastle in the title role and a reluctant Milhouse as his sidekick, Fallout Boy.

title: Home Sweet Home-Dum-Diddly Doodily
subtitle: Marge and Homer lose custody of the kids, who are sent next door to live with the Flanders family.

title: Bart Sells His Soul
subtitle: Bart casually sells his soul to Milhouse for $5 but soon regrets it; Moe converts his dank bar into a family restaurant.

title: Lisa the Vegetarian
subtitle: A trip to a local petting zoo convinces Lisa to give up meat, despite excessive pressure to convince her not to do so.

title: Treehouse of Horror VI
subtitle: A lightning storm causes giant advertising mascots to come to life; The children are terrorized by Groundskeeper Willie in their dreams; Homer finds himself trapped in another dimension.

title: King Size Homer
subtitle: Homer intentionally gains more weight in order to qualify for disability and work from home, but soon realizes that being morbidly obese comes with its own problems.

title: Mother Simpson
subtitle: After faking his own death, Homer is reunited with his mother, who harbors a deep secret.

title: Sideshow Bob's Last Gleaming
subtitle: Sideshow Bob escapes from prison to hijack a TV screen at an air show and demands that all television stations immediately go off the air, or else he will detonate an atomic bomb.

title: The Simpsons 138th Episode Spectacular!
subtitle: Troy McClure hosts a retrospective of the Simpson family's first eight years on television, including early shorts, classic highlights and never-before-seen outtakes.

title: Marge Be Not Proud
subtitle: Marge's relationship with Bart is strained when he is caught shoplifting before Christmas.

title: Team Homer
subtitle: Homer starts a bowling team with Moe, Apu and Otto, but Mr. Burns insists on joining after learning that the team was funded with his money; Springfield Elementary introduces uniforms.

title: Two Bad Neighbors
subtitle: Former President George Bush and his wife, Barbara, move into the Simpsons' neighborhood and soon clash with Bart and Homer.

title: Scenes from the Class Struggle in Springfield
subtitle: After buying a Chanel suit at a bargain price, Marge is invited to a country club by a former schoolmate, where she desperately tries to fit in with its upper class clientele.

title: Bart the Fink
subtitle: Krusty the Clown is left almost broke after Bart inadvertently rats him out to the IRS, forcing Krusty to take drastic action.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
subtitle: While researching for an essay, Lisa discovers that Springfield's founding father was actually a murderous thief.

title: Homer the Smithers
subtitle: When Smithers is forced to take a vacation, he appoints Homer as his temporary replacement.

title: The Day the Violence Died
subtitle: Bart and Lisa meet a vagabond who claims to be the creator of Itchy from "Itchy and Scratchy."

title: A Fish Called Selma
subtitle: Washed-up movie star Troy McClure starts dating Selma in an attempt to silence bizarre rumors about his personal life and resuscitate his career.

title: Bart on the Road
subtitle: Bart makes a fake driver's license and takes Milhouse, Martin, and Nelson on a huge road trip; Lisa spends time with Homer at the power plant.

title: 22 Short Films About Springfield
subtitle: A series of vignettes showcasing a day in the life of various Springfield residents.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in 'The Curse of the Flying Hellfish'
subtitle: After surviving multiple assassination attempts by Mr. Burns to inherit a cache of artwork they stole from the Nazis, Grampa teams up with Bart to recover the paintings.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
subtitle: Anti-immigration fever sweeps Springfield, which threatens to lead to the deportation of Apu, until Homer decides to reject the mob mentality and help him become a legal citizen.

title: Homerpalooza
subtitle: Homer takes Bart and Lisa to a music festival in an attempt to prove his coolness, but ends up embarrassing them after being hired to participate in the festival's freak show.

title: Summer of 4'2"
subtitle: After realizing how unpopular she is, a disillusioned Lisa sees the vacation to Ned Flanders' beach house as an opportunity to reinvent herself.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
subtitle: Bart's Siamese twin swells in the attic; Lisa's science experiment creates a miniature universe of advanced civilization; aliens possess Clinton and Dole.

title: You Only Move Twice
subtitle: The Simpsons move to the town of Cypress Creek, where Homer works for a friendly boss who happens to be a supervillain; the rest of the family has a hard time with the transfer.

title: The Homer They Fall
subtitle: Homer becomes a boxer after Moe discovers his amazing ability to take a punch.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
subtitle: The Simpsons try to reunite Mr. Burns with Larry, his slovenly long-lost son.

title: Bart After Dark
subtitle: Marge leads a crusade against a local burlesque house after she discovers Bart working there.

title: A Milhouse Divided
subtitle: Homer questions the state of his marriage after Luann Van Houten demands a divorce from Kirk.

title: Lisa's Date with Density
subtitle: Lisa develops a crush on Nelson, and tries to reform him; Homer gets an autodialer and decides to make easy money with a telemarketing scam.

title: Hurricane Neddy
subtitle: After a hurricane destroys Ned Flanders' house, he suffers a nervous breakdown and is forced to confront repressed problems from his childhood.

title: The Mysterious Voyage of Our Homer
subtitle: After eating insanity peppers at a chili cook-off, Homer has a hallucination of a talking coyote urging him to find his soulmate.

title: The Springfield Files
subtitle: Special Agents Mulder and Scully arrive in Springfield after Homer claims to have seen an alien.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
subtitle: Marge enters the pretzel vending business, but when she fails, Homer recruits some help from the mob.

title: Mountain of Madness
subtitle: Homer and Mr. Burns get trapped in a snowed-in cabin during a company retreat.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
subtitle: Marge is stressed from motherhood and hires a British nanny to help out around the house, who struggles to teach Bart and Lisa how to behave.

title: The Itchy & Scratchy & Poochie Show
subtitle: Homer is cast as Poochie, a new "Itchy and Scratchy" character designed to reverse declining ratings; a hip college student moves in with the Simpsons.

title: Homer's Phobia
subtitle: After Marge befriends John, a gay store owner, Homer worries that his presence will have a negative effect on Bart's sexuality.

title: Brother from Another Series
subtitle: Bart suspects a paroled Sideshow Bob is up to his old tricks when he is hired by his brother Cecil to assist in the construction of a dam.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
subtitle: Bart is outraged when Lisa becomes his babysitter.

title: Homer vs. the 18th Amendment
subtitle: After alcohol is banned in Springfield, Homer adopts the moniker of the "Beer Baron" to bootleg liquor, prompting an investigation from an uptight Treasury agent.

title: Grade School Confidential
subtitle: Bart discovers Principal Skinner and Mrs. Krabappel kissing, and it's not long before the whole town knows of their secret affair.

title: The Canine Mutiny
subtitle: When the items Bart purchased with a fake credit card are repossessed, he claims that Santa's Little Helper is the dog he bought instead of his new pet, Laddie.

title: The Old Man and the Lisa
subtitle: Burns loses his fortune and recruits Lisa to help him get it back.

title: In Marge We Trust
subtitle: Marge becomes a church counselor; Homer discovers his face on a Japanese detergent logo.

title: Homer's Enemy
subtitle: Homer's laziness begets the ire of his industrious but arrogant new co-worker Frank Grimes; Bart buys a run-down factory for a dollar.

title: The Simpsons Spin-Off Showcase
subtitle: Troy McClure presents three spinoffs: "Chief Wiggum, P.I.," "The Love-Matic Grandpa," and "The Simpson Family Smile-Time Variety Hour."

title: The Secret War of Lisa Simpson
subtitle: Bart is sent to a military school to be disciplined; Lisa, seeking a challenge, enrolls with him, but faces discrimination as the school's only girl cadet.

title: The City of New York vs. Homer Simpson
subtitle: Homer must travel to New York to get his car back, which is illegally parked at World Trade Center Plaza.

title: The Principal and the Pauper
subtitle: At his 20th anniversary celebration as school principal, Principal Skinner is discovered to be an imposter of the real Seymour Skinner.

title: Lisa's Sax
subtitle: Homer recounts the story of Bart's first day of school, which corresponds with the story of how Lisa got her saxophone.

title: Treehouse of Horror VIII
subtitle: Homer battles mutants after Springfield is annihilated by a neutron bomb; Bart has his DNA mixed with a fly; Marge is revealed to be a witch in colonial Springfield.

title: The Cartridge Family
subtitle: After a massive soccer riot, Homer purchases a gun to protect the family.

title: Bart Star
subtitle: A damning report on childhood obesity in Springfield leads to the formation of a pee-wee football team. After belittling Ned Flanders, Homer ends up coaching the team, but his favoring of Bart makes him unpopular.

title: The Two Mrs. Nahasapeemapetilons
subtitle: Apu receives a letter from his mother stating that it's time for him fulfilled his arranged marriage obligation, he pretends Marge is his wife.

title: Lisa the Skeptic
subtitle: Townspeople believe that Lisa has unearthed the fossilized remains of an angel.

title: Realty Bites
subtitle: Marge becomes a real-estate agent.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
subtitle: When Bart accidentally burns down the family's Christmas tree and gifts, he claims that a robber stole everything. As a result, the town gets them a new tree and pitches in to raise funds.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
subtitle: Homer is disappointed when the western he rented turns out to be a musical, so the family reminds him of the musical moments in the show's history.

title: Bart Carny
subtitle: Bart and Homer befriend two carnies and invite them to stay with them, but the carnies soon swindle the Simpsons out of their house.

title: The Joy of Sect
subtitle: An evil cult called the Movementarians brainwashes the citizens of Springfield and it's up to Marge to get them back.

title: Das Bus
subtitle: While the kids become stranded on a desert island, Homer attempts to cash in on the Internet.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
subtitle: After a disastrous performance, Krusty changes his image and becomes an edgy stand-up.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
subtitle: Homer and Moe attempt insurance fraud so that Moe can support his new girlfriend. When Homer ends up in jail, Moe has to decide whether or not to come forward.

title: Lisa the Simpson
subtitle: Lisa fears she is losing her intelligence when she learns about the fabled Simpson gene. Meanwhile, Jasper freezes himself in the Kwik-E-Mart freezer.

title: This Little Wiggy
subtitle: Bart is reluctant to hang out with Ralph Wiggum, until he gains access to Chief Wiggum's master key to the city.

title: Simpson Tide
subtitle: Homer causes an international incident after he joins the Naval reserves.

title: The Trouble with Trillions
subtitle: Homer is forced to spy for the IRS after an audit. But when he is asked to retrieve a trillion dollar bill from Mr. Burns, he switches sides and the two flee to Cuba for refuge.

title: Girly Edition
subtitle: Bart and Lisa become locked in competition when they anchor a children's news program; Homer adopts a helper monkey.

title: Trash of the Titans
subtitle: Homer becomes the sanitation commissioner for Springfield. His ineptitude pollutes the town and leads to a drastic solution.

title: King of the Hill
subtitle: After humiliating Bart at a church picnic, Homer resolves to get in shape. Soon, he is contacted by an energy bar company that wants him to climb a mountain as a promotion.

title: Lost Our Lisa
subtitle: Lisa gets lost after she tries to take a bus to a museum.

title: Natural Born Kissers
subtitle: Homer and Marge's attempt to spice up their marriage leads to the couple being chased naked through Springfield.

title: Lard of the Dance
subtitle: Homer and Bart try to start their own grease business; Lisa organizes a school dance.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
subtitle: Homer's midlife crisis leads to a disastrous attempt at being an inventor.

title: Bart the Mother
subtitle: When Bart accidentally kills a mother bird, he tries to make amends by raising the eggs.

title: Treehouse of Horror IX
subtitle: Homer receives an evil hair transplant; Bart and Lisa get trapped in an Itchy and Scratchy cartoon; Maggie is revealed to be an alien.

title: When You Dish Upon a Star
subtitle: Homer becomes a Hollywood insider when he befriends Alec Baldwin and Kim Basinger.

title: D'oh-in' in the Wind
subtitle: Homer becomes a hippie after a revelation about his middle name.

title: Lisa Gets an 'A'
subtitle: When Lisa cheats on a test, she has a moral crisis when her perfect score qualifies the school for grant money; Homer adopts a lobster as a pet.

title: Homer Simpson in: 'Kidney Trouble'
subtitle: Homer gets cold feet before a transplant operation which could save Grampa's life.

title: Mayored to the Mob
subtitle: Homer deals with corruption when he becomes Mayor Quimby's bodyguard.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
subtitle: When Homer takes Ned to Las Vegas in an attempt to get him to loosen up, the two end up drunkenly marrying a pair of cocktail waitresses.

title: Wild Barts Can't Be Broken
subtitle: The children of Springfield revolt after a curfew is enforced.

title: Sunday, Cruddy Sunday
subtitle: Homer and his friends head to the Super Bowl, but are forced to sneak in when they discover their tickets are counterfeit.

title: Homer to the Max
subtitle: Homer changes his name to "Max Power" after discovering that he shares his name with a dimwitted TV character.

title: I'm with Cupid
subtitle: The husbands of Springfield plot revenge after Apu outshines them on Valentine's Day.

title: Marge Simpson in: 'Screaming Yellow Honkers'
subtitle: Marge's new SUV gives her a potent case of road rage.

title: Make Room for Lisa
subtitle: Lisa feels that her relationship with her father will never be close, and she develops stress-induced stomach pains; Marge inadvertently knocks out Milhouse.

title: Maximum Homerdrive
subtitle: Homer takes Bart with him on a cross-country delivery on behalf of a trucker who died before completing it; Marge and Lisa experience problems with their new novelty doorbell.

title: Simpsons Bible Stories
subtitle: Three famous religious stories are retold Simpsons style as the family nods off at church.

title: Mom and Pop Art
subtitle: Homer becomes the talk of the Springfield art community when a failed barbecue pit he worked on is mistaken for an art project.

title: The Old Man and the 'C' Student
subtitle: Bart is punished with community service at the Retirement Castle after he ruins Springfield's chances of hosting the Olympics.

title: Monty Can't Buy Me Love
subtitle: When a wealthy man moves to Springfield, Mr. Burns begins to feel that he is losing his grasp on the citizens and decides to enlist the help of Homer.

title: They Saved Lisa's Brain
subtitle: Lisa is invited to join the Springfield chapter of MENSA and after Mayor Quimby flees, the group ends up running the city. Meanwhile, Homer poses for a series of erotic photos.

title: Thirty Minutes Over Tokyo
subtitle: The Simpsons must perform on a Japanese game show after Homer loses their money on a vacation.

title: Beyond Blunderdome
subtitle: Convinced he's the only man with guts to tell him the truth, Mel Gibson insists Homer accompanies him in Hollywood to help fix his newest film project.

title: Brother's Little Helper
subtitle: Bart is put on medication to control his behavior, but the pills cause him to become paranoid and insane.

title: Guess Who's Coming to Criticize Dinner?
subtitle: When Homer is hired as a local food critic by a newspaper in Springfield, he finds himself in deep trouble after his reviews turn out to be too critical.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
subtitle: The Simpsons attempt to cover up their accidental murder of Ned Flanders. Bart and Lisa acquire super powers. An electronic apocalypse threatens Springfield.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
subtitle: Homer cowards out of a pistol-duel and hides out with the rest of the family on a country farm.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
subtitle: Homer becomes a minor celebrity around Springfield after bowling a perfect game.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
subtitle: Apu struggles with fatherhood after Manjula gives birth to octuplets.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
subtitle: Homer's attempt at creating a motorcycle gang attracts a real gang, who kidnap Marge.

title: Grift of the Magi
subtitle: A toy company purchases Springfield Elementary and uses the student body as a focus group for their new Christmas toy Funzo.

title: Little Big Mom
subtitle: Lisa finds out how rough Marge has it when her mom is in traction and she becomes the woman of the house. Homer and Bart's antics get her so worked up she conspires to teach them a lesson.

title: Faith Off
subtitle: Bart is led to believe he has special healing powers after a tent revival.

title: The Mansion Family
subtitle: Homer receives responsibility for Mr. Burns' mansion when he is on leave and takes Burns' yacht to international waters to have a party.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
subtitle: The Simpsons get an abused horse and make him a contender in horse racing. Homer finds out a secret conspiracy about jockeys. Lisa tries to reach President Clinton when the results of a school band talent competition seem tainted.

title: Alone Again, Natura-Diddly
subtitle: Ned deals with his grief after Maude's untimely death.

title: Missionary: Impossible
subtitle: When Homer is wanted dead for reneging on a 10,000 dollar pledge to PBS, Reverend Lovejoy sets him up for missionary work in the South Pacific until the heat dies down.

title: Pygmoelian
subtitle: Plastic surgery not only transforms Moe the Bartender from ugly to hunky, it helps gets him a job on a hit daytime drama.

title: Bart to the Future
subtitle: Bart gets a glimpse of the future while the family is on vacation at an Indian casino.

title: Days of Wine and D'oh'ses
subtitle: Homer doesn't like it when Barney quits drinking; Bart and Lisa get into trouble when they enter a photo contest for the new phone book cover.

title: Kill the Alligator and Run
subtitle: Fearing he only has three years to live, Homer takes the family on a vacation to Florida, where they become fugitives after seemingly killing a famous alligator.

title: Last Tap Dance in Springfield
subtitle: Lisa has difficulties learning to tap dance; Bart and Milhouse ditch summer camp to spend a week living in the mall.

title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad Marge
subtitle: Everybody loves the new Simpsons' house guest Becky. Except Marge, who thinks Becky wants to kill her.

title: Behind the Laughter
subtitle: Fans are invited to take a behind-the-scenes look at "The Simpsons," revisiting some of the most memorable experiences the family has been through.

title: Treehouse of Horror XI
subtitle: Homer must do one good deed to get into Heaven; Bart and Lisa encounter a witch in a gingerbread house; Super-intelligent dolphins strike back at humanity.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
subtitle: Springfield is split in two when Homer revolts because his area code is changed; the new town walls itself off from the neighbors.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
subtitle: After he learns he has a daughter, Krusty turns to Homer for parenting advice.

title: Lisa the Treehugger
subtitle: Lisa's crush on an environmental activist inspires her to live in a tree threatened by loggers.

title: Homer vs. Dignity
subtitle: Desperate for money, Homer accepts payment from Mr. Burns in exchange for humiliating himself.

title: The Computer Wore Menace Shoes
subtitle: Homer's gossip website becomes a huge hit, but when his information runs out he resorts to making up news.

title: The Great Money Caper
subtitle: The whole town of Springfield conspires to teach Homer and Bart a lesson after the pair begin running confidence scams.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
subtitle: A freak blizzard traps the students of Springfield Elementary inside their school. Their lives at stake, they are at the mercy of the rescue efforts of a woozy Homer and Ned.

title: HOMR
subtitle: An X-ray reveals a crayon lodged in Homer's brain. After the crayon is removed, Homer experiences a sudden surge in intelligence, making him closer to Lisa and isolated from his friends.

title: Pokey Mom
subtitle: Marge befriends a convict with an artistic streak. Meanwhile, Homer battles the chiropractic industry after he creates a miracle back pain cure.

title: Worst Episode Ever
subtitle: Bart and Milhouse are left in charge of the comic book store after Comic Book Guy is hospitalized.

title: Tennis the Menace
subtitle: Homer installs a tennis court in the backyard, but his lousy playing creates a rift in the family.

title: Day of the Jackanapes
subtitle: When Krusty decides to retire after a new game show draws away his audience, a vengeful Sideshow Bob plots to have a hypnotized Bart assassinate him during his farewell special.

title: New Kids on the Blecch
subtitle: A music producer offers Bart and his friends a chance to participate in an up-and-coming boyband, but the boys are not up to it after making a discovery.

title: Hungry Hungry Homer
subtitle: Homer is forced to go on a hunger strike by the Springfield Isotopes after uncovering a secret plan to have the baseball team moved to New Mexico.

title: Bye Bye Nerdy
subtitle: Problems with a bully lead Lisa to examine just what makes bullies aggressive. Meanwhile, Homer gets into the baby-proofing business.

title: Simpson Safari
subtitle: The Simpsons win a trip to Africa after Homer finds a golden animal cracker from the 60's in the loft.

title: Trilogy of Error
subtitle: Homer's rush to the hospital to re-attach his severed thumb, Lisa's rush to school to win the science fair, and Bart's run-in with an illegal fireworks scheme interconnect from their point of view.

title: I'm Goin' to Praiseland
subtitle: With Homer's help, Flanders tries to establish a Christian theme park based on drawings in Maude's sketch book.

title: Children of a Lesser Clod
subtitle: After a debilitating injury forces him to stay indoors, Homer begins a daycare center.

title: Simpsons Tall Tales
subtitle: A hobo tells the Simpsons tall tales on a train ride:. In the first story, Homer is Paul Bunyan. In the second, Lisa stars as Connie Appleseed. And in the third, Bart and Nelson raft down the Mississippi as Tom Sawyer and Huck Finn.

title: Treehouse of Horror XII
subtitle: A gypsy puts a curse on Homer; The Simpsons' new automated house malfunctions and tries to kill Homer; Bart and Lisa attend a school for wizards.

title: The Parent Rap
subtitle: After Bart takes a joyride in a police car, a judge orders him to be tethered to Homer at all times.

title: Homer the Moe
subtitle: Homer and his friends are forced to drink in the Simpsons' garage after Moe the Bartender renovates his shady bar into a hipster hangout.

title: A Hunka Hunka Burns in Love
subtitle: Mr. Burns falls in love with a younger woman and recruits Homer to help him impress her.

title: The Blunder Years
subtitle: A hypnotist uncovers a traumatic experience from Homer's childhood that he had sealed away for years. What exactly happened, and what hand does Mr Burns have in all this?

title: She of Little Faith
subtitle: Homer and Bart get careless with a model rocket and accidentally do damage to Springfield's church, but when Mr. Burns offers to commercialize it to repair the destruction, Lisa leaves Christianity behind to become a Buddhist.

title: Brawl in the Family
subtitle: A social services officer brings unity to the Simpson family, but their newfound happiness is threatened when the cocktail waitress Homer married in Vegas shows up at their door.

title: Sweets and Sour Marge
subtitle: Marge rallies for a ban on sugar after Springfield is declared America's fattest city.

title: Jaws Wired Shut
subtitle: Marge can't deal with the quiet after Homer has his jaws wired shut.

title: Half-Decent Proposal
subtitle: Marge's high school sweetheart Artie Ziff returns and offers Homer a million dollars to spend a weekend with Marge.

title: The Bart Wants What It Wants
subtitle: Bart breaks up with his new girlfriend Greta, but gets jealous when she begins dating Milhouse.

title: The Lastest Gun in the West
subtitle: Bart meets a retired cowboy movie star and convinces him to make a comeback on The Krusty the Clown Show.

title: The Old Man and the Key
subtitle: Abe gets his driver's license back to impress a new woman at the retirement home.

title: Tales from the Public Domain
subtitle: Homer reads three stories from an overdue library book, imagining himself as Odysseus, Lisa as Joan of Arc, and Bart as Hamlet.

title: Blame It on Lisa
subtitle: Lisa sponsors an orphan in Brazil, and when he goes missing she convinces the family to go to Brazil to find him. While there, Homer is kidnapped.

title: Weekend at Burnsie's
subtitle: After a traumatizing eye injury, Homer becomes a habitual user of medical marijuana.

title: Gump Roast
subtitle: In this clip show, the citizens of Springfield honor Homer Simpsons with a Roast, but the festivities take a turn for the worst when aliens crash it.

title: I Am Furious Yellow
subtitle: Bart's comic about Homer becomes a hit on-line, prompting Homer to attempt to control his anger.

title: The Sweetest Apu
subtitle: Apu's marriage is on the rocks after Manjula finds out he cheated on her.

title: Little Girl in the Big Ten
subtitle: Lisa pretends to be a college student when she befriends two college girls; Bart is forced to live in a plastic bubble after being bitten by a mosquito.

title: The Frying Game
subtitle: Homer and Marge find themselves on death row after they are framed for murder.

title: Papa's Got a Brand New Badge
subtitle: Homer becomes chief of police after a scandal forces Wiggum out.

title: Treehouse of Horror XIII
subtitle: Homer clones himself with a magic hammock; Zombie cowboys come back from the dead after Springfield bans guns; The Simpsons family take a vacation on an island where Dr. Hibbert can turn people into animals.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
subtitle: When Homer is secretly videotaped complaining about his family in a taxi, they send him off to a rock and roll fantasy camp so he can try to live his dream.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. 3rd Grade
subtitle: Bart and Lisa are respectively held back and moved forward one grade, putting them in the same class.

title: Large Marge
subtitle: Marge accidentally gets breast implants.

title: Helter Shelter
subtitle: The Simpsons family must participate in a reality television show in which they try to live in the same way that the families did in the 1800s.

title: The Great Louse Detective
subtitle: Homer survives an assassination attempt and the police struggle to find a lead. Who is the only person in Springfield with cunning to help them crack the case? Sideshow Bob.

title: Special Edna
subtitle: After Skinner once again has let Mrs. Krabappel down, Bart nominates her for Teacher of the Year. When the nomination is accepted, Skinner tries to get back Krabappel by asking her to marry him.

title: The Dad Who Knew Too Little
subtitle: Homer hires a private detective to learn more about Lisa.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
subtitle: Marge takes up body-building to boost her self-esteem after being mugged at the Kwik-E-Mart.

title: Pray Anything
subtitle: Homer turns to religion to help him get what he wants and is soon awarded the church in an injury settlement. He then turns the church into his personal party pad and Reverend Lovejoy leaves Springfield to wallow in its hedonism.

title: Barting Over
subtitle: After finding out Homer squandered his money from a baby commercial, Bart moves out into a loft, and meets skateboarding legend Tony Hawk.

title: I'm Spelling as Fast as I Can
subtitle: Lisa participates in the Spellympics, but Homer is busy traveling cross-country as Krusty Burger test-markets a new sandwich. Lisa is confident that she will win, until she learns that the contest is rigged against her.

title: A Star Is Born Again
subtitle: Ned Flanders starts dating a famous movie star, but has difficulties with the tabloids following them everywhere.

title: Mr. Spritz Goes to Washington
subtitle: The family makes Krusty run for Congress because of air traffic being redirected to fly dangerously close to their house.

title: C.E.D'oh
subtitle: Homer takes over the power plant after tricking Mr. Burns into making him the official owner of the power plant.

title: 'Scuse Me While I Miss the Sky
subtitle: Lisa becomes interested in astronomy and starts fighting the light pollution which is preventing her from being able to enjoy her new hobby.

title: Three Gays of the Condo
subtitle: When Homer finds an old note revealing Marge only married him because she was pregnant with Bart, he moves into a condo with two gay guys.

title: Dude, Where's My Ranch?
subtitle: Homer writes a Christmas carol called "Everybody Hates Ned Flanders," which soon becomes so popular that the family decides to leave town for a while.

title: Old Yeller-Belly
subtitle: Homer throws out Santa's Little Helper for not saving him from a fire, but soon the dog becomes Duff's new mascot.

title: Brake My Wife, Please
subtitle: Because of Homer losing his driver's license, Marge has to drive everyone everywhere, which is so stressful for her that she accidentally runs over Homer leading to the two seeing a marriage counselor.

title: The Bart of War
subtitle: Bart and Milhouse are forced into community service after destroying Flanders' memorial and join separate community groups, pitting themselves against each other.

title: Moe Baby Blues
subtitle: After saving Maggie's life, Moe develops a special bond with her, much to Homer's dismay.

title: Treehouse of Horror XIV
subtitle: Homer gets a new job, as the Grim Reaper. Professor Frink brings back his father from beyond the grave, and Bart and Milhouse freeze time.

title: My Mother the Carjacker
subtitle: Homer's mother returns to Springfield, and the city pardons her from the charges against her. Mr. Burns is furious about this and makes a plan to get Mona Simpson in prison.

title: The President Wore Pearls
subtitle: Lisa feuds with Principal Skinner after being elected school president.

title: The Regina Monologues
subtitle: Prime minister Tony Blair welcomes the Simpsons to England where they run into author J.K. Rowling and actor Ian McKellen.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
subtitle: At the dump Homer is videotaped while being attacked by a bear. The town regards him a coward, so Homer decides to strike back at the bear.

title: Today, I Am a Clown
subtitle: Krusty decides to do what he never did when he was thirteen years old - have a Bar Mitzvah.

title: 'Tis the Fifteenth Season
subtitle: After spending all his money on an expensive gift for himself, and the family thinking he should be less of an egoist, Homer decides to change his ways.

title: Marge vs. Singles, Seniors, Childless Couples and Teens and Gays
subtitle: A concert for babies ends in a riot, so the childless adults of Springfield gather to make the town less child-friendly.

title: I, (Annoyed Grunt)-Bot
subtitle: Homer pretends to be a robot and competes in Robot Wars to win Bart's affection; Lisa has cat trouble.

title: Diatribe of a Mad Housewife
subtitle: Marge is inspired to write a novel, but the storyline of the book (a fat, mean husband, and a handsome, sweet neighbor) makes Homer jealous.

title: Margical History Tour
subtitle: Marge tells Lisa, Bart and Millhouse three history stories because the library doesn't have any.

title: Milhouse Doesn't Live Here Anymore
subtitle: Milhouse moves to Capitol City, and therefore Lisa and Bart become best friends.

title: Smart & Smarter
subtitle: When Maggie is revealed to have an IQ of 167, Lisa is no longer the genius of the family, causing a rivalry between the sisters.

title: The Ziff Who Came to Dinner
subtitle: Artie Ziff is discovered hiding out in the Simpsons' attic.

title: Co-Dependent's Day
subtitle: Marge takes up heavy drinking to spend more time with Homer. Bart and Lisa confront a famous movie director about the drop in quality his films have taken.

title: The Wandering Juvie
subtitle: After playing a prank on the whole town, Bart is sentenced to six months of juvenile detention. There he meets Gina, who forces Bart to escape with her.

title: My Big Fat Geek Wedding
subtitle: Mrs. Krabapel falls for Comic Book Guy and they plan a Star Trek like wedding. Principal Skinner plans to prevent it.

title: Catch 'Em If You Can
subtitle: Homer and Marge try to have a vacation without the kids but Bart and Lisa follow them everywhere they go.

title: Simple Simpson
subtitle: Homer becomes a costumed vigilante who uses pies for weapons after witnessing Lisa get humiliated at a competition at the state fair.

title: The Way We Weren't
subtitle: Marge and Homer find out that they actually kissed each other at age 10 without knowing they were each other's first kisses, and tell the story about this.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
subtitle: An accidental photo showing Bart mooning the American flag makes the Simpsons the most hated family in town.

title: Fraudcast News
subtitle: After Mr. Burns is erroneously reported as dead, he buys all of he media outlets in order to prevent them from writing scathing articles about him.

title: Treehouse of Horror XV
subtitle: Ned gains the power to foresee people's deaths; Maggie is shrunk inside a vitamin capsule and swallowed; Eliza Simpson and her sidekick hunt down a murderer.

title: All's Fair in Oven War
subtitle: Homer buys Marge a new kitchen, and Marge likes cooking in the new kitchen so much she attends the Ovenfresh Bakeoff.

title: Sleeping with the Enemy
subtitle: Because she thinks her own children do not appreciate her anymore, Marge becomes a mother figure for Nelson.

title: She Used to Be My Girl
subtitle: Marge becomes jealous when Lisa begins idolizing her old high school friend, Chloe Talbot, a famous reporter.

title: Fat Man and Little Boy
subtitle: Bart begins designing T-shirt slogans, and his T-shirts become very popular among the citizens of Springfield.

title: Midnight Rx
subtitle: Homer goes to Canada with Apu and Ned to purchase Grampa's medication, but the three have problems getting home because the border guard thinks Apu is a terrorist.

title: Mommie Beerest
subtitle: Homer gives Moe an enormous amount of money so he doesn't have to close down.

title: Homer and Ned's Hail Mary Pass
subtitle: A video of Homer dancing becomes so popular that all major sports players hires Homer to design celebration dances for them.

title: Pranksta Rap
subtitle: Bart went to a rap concert Marge told him not to go to. In order to avoid punishment from Marge, he makes Marge and Homer believe he has been kidnapped.

title: There's Something About Marrying
subtitle: A townsperson comes out of the closet when Springfield legalized same-sex marriages in a plot to bolster tourism; Homer uses the Internet to become a minister.

title: On a Clear Day I Can't See My Sister
subtitle: After bullying her, Bart is restricted by court order to not come too close to Lisa.

title: Goo Goo Gai Pan
subtitle: Selma decides to adopt a child, so the whole family goes to China.

title: Mobile Homer
subtitle: After a garage-cleaning accident, Marge wants Homer to get life insurance. Instead, the family gets an RV.

title: The Seven-Beer Snitch
subtitle: Springfield builds an opera house, but since no-one attends it they convert it into a prison. Old and forgotten laws are used to fill the prison, and therefore Homer goes to jail for kicking a can five times in a row. In jail, Homer becomes a snitch

title: Future-Drama
subtitle: Bart and Lisa see into the future where their lives have changed.

title: Don't Fear the Roofer
subtitle: Homer meets a new friend, Ray the Roofer, but gets confined to a mental institution when his friends and family think he made him up.

title: The Heartbroke Kid
subtitle: Bart starts living on food from the new candy machine in school only, but he becomes so overweight that he has to go to a fat camp.

title: A Star Is Torn
subtitle: Lisa attends a singing competition for children, and Homer becomes her manager because of his skill to write songs that the crowd loves.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
subtitle: Homer hears about the Rapture, and by using numerology to calculate when the Rapture is coming he learns that it is only one week away.

title: Home Away from Homer
subtitle: After Homer humiliates Ned Flanders, Ned, Rod, and Todd decides to leave Springfield and live in Humbleton, Pennsylvania.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
subtitle: Bart is expelled from Springfield Elementary, and Bart is therefore enrolled in St. Jerome's Catholic School.

title: The Bonfire of the Manatees
subtitle: When Marge leaves Homer because he allowed an adult movie being shot in their house, she seeks self-fulfillment in protecting manatees.

title: The Girl Who Slept Too Little
subtitle: A new cemetery right outside the window of Lisa's room makes Lisa suffer from many sleepless nights.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
subtitle: When Kirk and Luann van Houten plan to get back together, Milhouse realizes they are too interested in each other, so he and Bart try to break them up, only for the plan to backfire and cause Homer and Marge to break up yet again.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
subtitle: An android son replaces Bart; Homer and friends are the quarry in Mr. Burns' hunting tournament; a witch turns townsfolk into their Halloween costumes.

title: Marge's Son Poisoning
subtitle: Marge and Bart start spending more time together, and make a tradition of cycling to a tea house in a small village outside Springfield.

title: See Homer Run
subtitle: When a recall election puts Mayor Quimby's job up for grabs, Homer seizes the opportunity to win office and gain his daughter's love.

title: The Last of the Red Hat Mamas
subtitle: Milhouse tutors Lisa in Italian, and Marge joins the Cheery Red Tomatoes, a group that plans to rob Mr. Burns of one million dollars worth of Fabergé eggs.

title: The Italian Bob
subtitle: The Simpsons become lost in Italy, finding their way to a small town that Sideshow Bob has become the mayor of.

title: Simpsons Christmas Stories
subtitle: Homer tells the tale of the first Christmas ever, while Grandpa pursues his decade-old feud with Santa.

title: Homer's Paternity Coot
subtitle: When a frozen mailman from the 60's is found in a Springfield glacier, doubts arise about whether Abe really is Homer's father.

title: We're on the Road to D'ohwhere
subtitle: When Homer is on his way to Vegas to meet up with his friends, he has to make a detour to take Bart to an education camp. Meanwhile, Marge has discovered a surprising source of income.

title: My Fair Laddy
subtitle: Bart and Lisa bet whether Lisa can turn Groundskeeper Willie into a proper gentleman.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
subtitle: In this story within a story within a story within a story, a cave-exploring expedition, an angry sheep and a lovestruck Moe become inextricably entwined.

title: Bart Has Two Mommies
subtitle: Marge starts babysitting the Flanders boys, leading Homer to spend more time with Bart and Lisa. Bart gets kidnapped by a lonely movie chimpanzee.

title: Homer Simpson, This Is Your Wife
subtitle: As part of a new Fox show, the Simpsons participate in a wife-swap.

title: Million Dollar Abie
subtitle: After blowing Springfield's chances for an NFL franchise, Grandpa goes to an assisted-suicide center, then becomes a bullfighter.

title: Kiss Kiss, Bang Bangalore
subtitle: Homer gets sent to India when the power plant is relocated there. Selma and Patty kidnap Richard Dean Anderson after he spurns their MacGyver fan club.

title: The Wettest Stories Ever Told
subtitle: While waiting for the dinner at the Frying Dutchman, the family starts telling three stories about ships: "Journey on the Mayflower", "Mutiny on the Bounty", and "The Neptune Adventure".

title: Girls Just Want to Have Sums
subtitle: Springfield Elementary is divided into two separate schools (one for boys, one for girls) following Principal Skinner's demotion. Concerned that the boys are receiving a higher standard of education, Lisa disguises herself as a boy.

title: Regarding Margie
subtitle: After hitting her head on a stool Marge suffers from amnesia. Slowly but surely memories are starting to come back, except memories about Homer.

title: The Monkey Suit
subtitle: After his sons see a pro-evolution exhibit at a museum, Flanders demands Springfield Elementary teaches Creationism in its place, but Lisa fights for evolution lessons to be reinstated.

title: Homer and Marge Turn a Couple Play
subtitle: Marge and Homer try their luck at celebrity marriage counselling.

title: The Mook, the Chef, the Wife and Her Homer
subtitle: When Fat Tony has to take a time-out due to a whacking attempt, Homer and Bart take over the business.

title: Jazzy & The Pussycats
subtitle: Lisa becomes depressed when Bart becomes a better jazz musician than her. So she decides to set up an animal shelter in the Simpsons' attic.

title: Please Homer, Don't Hammer 'Em
subtitle: Marge begins her own carpentry business, but Homer becomes the face of the business because nobody will take a female carpenter seriously. And Bart uses Principal Skinner's peanut allergy to his advantage.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
subtitle: A meteorite turns Homer into a rampaging blob with a voracious appetite; Bart brings a Golem to life; an alien invasion hoax turns real.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
subtitle: Homer is duped into signing up for the Army, and his hijinks after basic training ultimately results in a military occupation of Springfield.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
subtitle: Lisa helps Moe become a distinguished poet, but she turns on him when he takes all the credit for his newfound greatness.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
subtitle: Homer becomes an ice cream man after being fired from the plant, and Marge uses his leftover Popsicle sticks to create folk art figures.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
subtitle: Bart and Nelson become best friends, but Bart surprisingly discovers that the fringe benefits aren't worth Nelson's neediness.

title: Kill Gil, Vol. 1 & 2
subtitle: The Simpsons let Gil stay with them during Christmas. However, he stays for 11 months because Marge can't tell him "no."

title: The Wife Aquatic
subtitle: Homer returns Marge to Barnacle Bay, where she spent her beloved summer vacations. But when they get there, they discover that it is no longer a tourist spot.

title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Three Times
subtitle: While Homer tries to get revenge on a driver who cut him off, his family warns him of the folly of revenge by telling stories based on "The Count of Monte Cristo," "Revenge of the Nerds," and "Batman."

title: Little Big Girl
subtitle: Lisa embellishes her family heritage as Native American for a school project; Bart gets a driver's license and develops a relationship with an older girl.

title: Springfield Up
subtitle: A parody of the "Up Series" of British documentaries, in which a filmmaker follows Homer and his friends from grade school into their 40s.

title: Yokel Chords
subtitle: In this parody of La novicia rebelde (1965), Lisa becomes a tutor for Cletus' seven children, until Krusty tries to exploit them as entertainers. Meanwhile, Bart becomes emotionally attached to his school-appointed psychiatrist.

title: Rome-old and Juli-eh
subtitle: Homer and Patty object to Grampa and Selma's marriage; Bart and Lisa build an elaborate fort out of ill-gotten cardboard boxes.

title: Homerazzi
subtitle: Homer becomes a successful Paparazzi, but Springfield's celebrities decide to get their revenge on him.

title: Marge Gamer
subtitle: Marge decides to find out what their Internet has to offer and soon gets hooked on an online role-playing game; Homer referees Lisa's soccer game.

title: The Boys of Bummer
subtitle: Bart becomes the most hated person in Springfield after he is the goat in a championship baseball game, and Homer's new job as a mattress salesman ruins his and Marge's sex life.

title: Crook and Ladder
subtitle: Homer, Moe, Apu and Principal Skinner become volunteer firefighters. But just because they're not getting paid doesn't mean that they can't find a way to receive compensation.

title: Stop, or My Dog Will Shoot!
subtitle: Homer unwittingly drags the family into a cornfield maze after attempting to leave a boring Harvest fest that Marge brought them to. When everyone except Homer escapes, Santa's Little Helper rescues him and becomes the town hero. So the Simpsons enroll him in Police Dog Academy where he's teamed with Lou.

title: 24 Minutes
subtitle: Bart and Lisa join forces to stop the school bullies from setting off a stink bomb at the school bake sale.

title: You Kent Always Say What You Want
subtitle: After Kent Brockman is fired as a news anchor, he and Lisa use the Internet to expose the Fox News Conspiracy.

title: He Loves to Fly and He D'ohs
subtitle: Homer falls in love with private planes after taking a flight to Chicago with Mr. Burns. So Marge hires Homer a "life manager" to help him think positively and find a job that will allow him to fly for a living.

title: Homer of Seville
subtitle: Homer becomes an opera star after an injury improves his singing voice. His newfound popularity forces him to hire a personal assistant, who turns out to be an obsessed stalker.

title: Midnight Towboy
subtitle: Homer becomes the most hated man in town after he becomes a tow truck driver, and Marge teaches Maggie to not be an over-dependent baby.

title: I Don't Wanna Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
subtitle: Marge promises to visit a convicted bank robber in prison, but is afraid to follow through. But when the convict escapes from prison, Marge is the first person he pays a visit to.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVIII
subtitle: The eighteenth Simpsons Halloween Special features parodies of the movies "E.T." and "Mr. and Mrs. Smith."

title: Little Orphan Millie
subtitle: Milhouse's parents are lost at sea, which causes him to become a troubled loner. But his new persona makes him the new most popular kid at school, which sparks jealousy in Bart.

title: Husbands and Knives
subtitle: When Marge becomes a successful businesswoman, Homer becomes worried that she will dump him for a trophy husband. Therefore, he decides to have plastic surgery to make himself look like a hunk.

title: Funeral for a Fiend
subtitle: Bart is responsible for Sideshow Bob's death after his latest attempt at revenge is foiled, but is his death actually part of the plan?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
subtitle: Homer goes to Dr. Frink to help him recover his memories from the night before, and he discovers, based on his interpretation of the memories, that Marge is having an affair.

title: E Pluribus Wiggum
subtitle: Springfield becomes the site of the first presidential primary. The townspeople soon get sick of all of the presidential candidates sucking up to them, and decide to support their own write-in candidate: Ralph Wiggum.

title: That '90s Show
subtitle: Homer and Marge tell the kids about their life in the early 1990s before they were born, when Marge was enrolled in Springfield College and Homer was the lead singer of a grunge rock band.

title: Love, Springfieldian Style
subtitle: A series of romantic Valentine's Day parodies based on "Bonnie and Clyde," "Lady and the Tramp," and "Sid and Nancy."

title: The DeBarted
subtitle: The new prankster in Bart's fourth grade class actually turns out to be a mole brought in by Principal Skinner to infiltrate Bart's inner circle. Homer falls in love with his loaner car after Marge wrecks their old one.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
subtitle: One of Bart's pranks results in Martin's death, but Lisa doesn't want him to confess because she would be considered an accomplice. Marge hires a television crew to find out if Homer is cheating on his diet.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
subtitle: Marge has Lisa take up ballet, mainly to have Lisa live out her own childhood dreams. Lisa then succumbs to peer pressure from her ballet mates and takes up smoking. Meanwhile, Homer and Bart try to start their own beef jerky business.

title: Papa Don't Leech
subtitle: When the Simpsons discover that Lurleen Lumpkin is on the skids, Marge reluctantly agrees to take her in and help her find her deadbeat dad who abandoned her 30 years ago.

title: Apocalypse Cow
subtitle: Bart tries to save the cow he raised for his 4-H club from the slaughterhouse, and in the process winds up getting accidentally engaged to one of Cletus's daughters.

title: Any Given Sundance
subtitle: Lisa's documentary about her family is accepted into the Sundance Film Festival. However, her family gets upset with her when they discover that the film is far from flattering.

title: Mona Leaves-a
subtitle: Homer's mom dies, and as part of her will, she asks him to spread her ashes. However, her request turns out to be part of her final act of rebellion against the system.

title: All About Lisa
subtitle: In a parody of "All About Eve," Lisa stabs Krusty in the back, takes his job, and wins a prestigious award. Meanwhile, Homer and Bart take up coin collecting.

title: Sex, Pies and Idiot Scrapes
subtitle: Homer and Ned go into business together as bounty hunters, and Marge takes a job at an erotic bakery.

title: Lost Verizon
subtitle: Bart gets in trouble with Marge after she finds out that he has Denis Leary's cell phone and is using it to make prank phone calls.

title: Double, Double, Boy in Trouble
subtitle: Bart trades lives with his multi-millionaire lookalike, but discovers that his lookalike's life isn't all he thought it would be.

title: Treehouse of Horror XIX
subtitle: The Simpsons' 19th Halloween Special, with parodies of "Transformers," "Mad Men," and "It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown."

title: Dangerous Curves
subtitle: The Simpsons take a Fourth of July vacation to a cabin hotel, which cause Homer and Marge to reminisce about two episodes from their past where they stayed in the cabin.

title: Homer and Lisa Exchange Cross Words
subtitle: Homer gets a job breaking up couples, and Lisa becomes an expert crossword puzzle solver, but Homer bets against her in a competition.

title: MyPods and Boomsticks
subtitle: Homer suspects that the family of Bart's new Muslim friend from Jordan is part of a terrorist plot, and Lisa becomes obsessed with her new MyPod.

title: The Burns and the Bees
subtitle: Lisa goes to extreme lengths to save Springfield's bees, only to have Mr Burns demolish her newfound sanctuary to build a stadium in an attempt to make himself, and his newly acquired basketball team more popular.

title: Lisa the Drama Queen
subtitle: Lisa and her new best friend create their own fantasy world, but Marge doesn't want Lisa to see her friend anymore after she finds out that they're too far gone in it.

title: Take My Life, Please
subtitle: Homer finds out that he actually won the senior class president election, and he gets an opportunity to find out how his life would have been different if it had happened.

title: How the Test Was Won
subtitle: Bart and his fellow underachievers are taken on a "field trip" to Capital City so that they can miss the standardized test, and Homer makes sure that nothing bad happens until their insurance goes back into effect.

title: No Loan Again, Naturally
subtitle: The Simpsons lose their house, but Flanders buys it and offers to rent it back to them. But when they turn out to be less-than-reliable renters, Flanders kicks them out.

title: Gone Maggie Gone
subtitle: In order to rescue Maggie from a Catholic orphanage, Lisa must solve a series of puzzles to reveal the identity of a gem that will bring peace to Springfield.

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
subtitle: The Simpsons take Grandpa to Ireland so he can go back to visit a pub he went to during the war, but Grandpa and Homer get suckered into buying the bar.

title: Wedding for Disaster
subtitle: Homer is kidnapped moments before he and Marge are supposed to re-renew their vows. However, Marge comes to the conclusion that Homer left her at the altar.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
subtitle: Moe begins dating a little person he met on the Internet, while Maggie is being bullied at the playground next to Moe's where Homer is leaving her.

title: The Good, the Sad and the Drugly
subtitle: Bart gets Milhouse to take the rap for a prank at school, and then blows him off when he falls for a cute 5th grade do-gooder, prompting Milhouse's wrath. Meanwhile, Lisa begins taking "happy pills" to improve her negative outlook.

title: Father Knows Worst
subtitle: Homer becomes a "helicopter parent" at Springfield Elementary by helping Bart finish a class project and helping Lisa become popular, and Marge finds a secret sauna in their house.

title: Waverly Hills, 9021-D'Oh
subtitle: The Simpsons set up a fake residence in Waverly Hills so that Bart and Lisa can attend school there.

title: Four Great Women and a Manicure
subtitle: Marge and Lisa tell stories inspired by three royal women: Queen Elizabeth I, Snow White, and Lady MacBeth. And one story about a man, Howard Roark, played by Maggie.

title: Coming to Homerica
subtitle: Townspeople build a wall around Springfield to keep "immigrants" from Ogdenville from relocating to their town.

title: Homer the Whopper
subtitle: A Hollywood studio makes a movie based on Comic Book Guy's comic book character "Everyman," and Homer is cast in the lead. However, Homer's weight fluctuations cause problems for the production.

title: Bart Gets a 'Z'
subtitle: When Bart's prank gets Ms. Krabappel fired from Springfield Elementary School, he tries to make it up to her without letting her know that he was responsible.

title: The Great Wife Hope
subtitle: Marge takes on the owner of an ultimate fighting league in the ring in order to get the sport banned in Springfield.

title: Treehouse of Horror XX
subtitle: Lisa becomes livid with Miss Hoover, and in a series of homages to classic Hitchcock sets out for deadly revenge. Next, Krusty's latest fast-food sandwich transforms news anchor Kent Brockman into an enraged zombie and twenty-eight days later, cannibal zombies have overrun Springfield. In the final frightening fable, Homer accidentally falls through a trapdoor in Moe's tavern and impales himself on the pipes of Moe's microbrewery. Moe serves the barflies a glass of delicious beer flavored with Homer's blood and Homer, now half-man, half-brewing apparatus, returns for vengeance.

title: The Devil Wears Nada
subtitle: Marge rediscovers her sexuality after appearing in a racy calendar, but Homer is too tired to respond to her advances because he is being worked to death by his new boss, Carl.

title: Pranks and Greens
subtitle: Bart discovers there is a more infamous prankster than him and sets out to find Skinner's former nemesis. Marge's mummy group pressure her to go organic or they'll boycott snack time at her house.

title: Rednecks and Broomsticks
subtitle: Homer becomes an expert on moonshine when he starts hanging out with Cletus after he saves the Simpsons' lives, while Lisa becomes friends with three teenage Wiccans.

title: Oh Brother, Where Bart Thou?
subtitle: Bart becomes jealous of Maggie and Lisa's special bond as sisters, so he goes to an orphanage and "adopts" a little brother.

title: Thursdays with Abie
subtitle: Homer becomes jealous when a syndicated newspaper columnist begins publishing Grandpa's stories, while Bart is assigned to take care of the class's stuffed sheep for the weekend.

title: Once Upon a Time in Springfield
subtitle: The antagonism between Krusty and the new female co-star forced upon him soon turns to romance, while a headhunter encourages Homer, Lenny and Carl to take a job at another nuclear power plant.
