title: Million Dollar Maybe
subtitle: Homer can't tell Marge he won the lottery because he was supposed to be giving a wedding toast when he bought the ticket. But Bart soon finds out where he's hiding the money and begins to blackmail him.

title: Boy Meets Curl
subtitle: Homer and Marge become members of the U.S. Olympic curling team. At the games, Lisa becomes addicted to collecting pins, and Bart tries to save her.

title: The Color Yellow
subtitle: While searching for an admirable ancestor for a class project, Lisa discovers the story of a relative named Eliza Simpson, who may or may not have helped a slave escape to freedom.

title: Postcards from the Wedge
subtitle: When Bart unsuccessfully tries to play Homer and Marge against each other, he comes up with a dangerous prank that is sure to get their attention.

title: Stealing First Base
subtitle: Bart gets Springfield Elementary School in legal trouble when he kisses the enigmatic daughter of two lawyers, while Lisa is depressed about being ostracized because she is smart.

title: The Greatest Story Ever D'ohed
subtitle: Ned takes the Simpsons on a pilgrimage to Israel in order to try and save Homer, but soon discovers that he may not be worth saving.

title: American History X-cellent
subtitle: Mr Burns is sent to prison for art theft, where a scary inmate introduces him to religion. Meanwhile Smithers becomes the boss at the plant, and Bart and Lisa try to share an ant farm.

title: Chief of Hearts
subtitle: Homer and Chief Wiggum's new friendship is put to the test when the chief becomes needy after being shot, while Marge suspects that Bart may be dealing drugs.

title: The Squirt and the Whale
subtitle: After a violent storm, Lisa tries to rally the townspeople and come to the rescue of a beached whale.

title: To Surveil, with Love
subtitle: Springfield covers the town with surveillance cameras after Homer creates a bomb scare at the train station. Meanwhile, Lisa considers becoming a brunette so that people will take her more seriously.

title: Moe Letter Blues
subtitle: Homer, Apu and Reverend Lovejoy all suspect that Moe may have left with one of their wives after receiving a mysterious letter, but which one is it?

title: The Bob Next Door
subtitle: Bart is convinced that the Simpsons' new friendly, unassuming neighbor is actually Sideshow Bob in disguise.

title: Judge Me Tender
subtitle: Moe's gruff and abrasive personality makes him the perfect hyper-critical judge, and lands him a spot on American Idol. Meanwhile, Homer makes Marge uncomfortable when he starts spending more time at home with Moe's now closed.

title: Elementary School Musical
subtitle: While Homer and Bart accompany Krusty to Oslo so he can receive the Nobel Peace Prize, Marge enrolls Lisa for a week in performing arts camp.

title: Loan-a Lisa
subtitle: Lisa uses the $50 she receives from Grandpa to give Nelson a microloan to jump-start his bicycle business, but soon comes to regret the decision.

title: MoneyBart
subtitle: Lisa takes over as manager of Bart's baseball team and uses statistical analysis to build a winner, but she takes all of the fun out of it and causes Bart to quit the team.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
subtitle: A Satanic board game causes other popular board games to come to life, Homer and Marge rescue a possible killer and let him on their boat, and a parody of "Twilight" where Lisa falls for a young vampire.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
subtitle: When Lisa discovers that Marge was also a model student, she tries to find out where everything changed so that she doesn't repeat her mistakes. Meanwhile, a series of chance accidents cause Bart to replace Nelson as school bully.

title: The Fool Monty
subtitle: After Mr. Burns finds out that he is dying, he has an accident and loses his memory, and all the townspeople use the situation to get their revenge on him.

title: How Munched Is That Birdie in the Window?
subtitle: Bart adopts a carrier pigeon, but Santa's Little Helper eats it.

title: The Fight Before Christmas
subtitle: Marge gets depressed when the rest of the family does not get into the holiday spirit, and she writes a letter, hoping to get some help; Mr. Burns and Moe's new friend delay the Simpsons as they attempt to travel to Hawaii for the holiday.

title: Donnie Fatso
subtitle: Homer goes to prison after attempting to get out of a series of fines with a bribe, but agrees to a reduced sentence by informing on Fat Tony for the FBI.

title: Moms I'd Like to Forget
subtitle: Bart sets out to uncover the origins of a sword-shaped scar on his hand; Marge reconnects with three friends she fell out with years ago.

title: Flaming Moe
subtitle: Moe tries to keep his 'straightness' a secret when he opens a gay bar; Skinner falls for a new teacher.

title: Homer the Father
subtitle: Homer picks up parenting advice from an 80s sitcom; Bart becomes involved in trading nuclear secrets.

title: The Blue and the Gray
subtitle: Moe employs Homer as his wing man, only to find Homer has more luck with the ladies than he does; Marge finds her first gray hair.

title: Angry Dad: The Movie
subtitle: Bart's "Angry Dad" character gets his own movie, but when the movie starts winning awards, Homer tries to hog all the credit.

title: The Scorpion's Tale
subtitle: Lisa's school project leads to the discovery of a new drug that makes the elderly less cranky and more tolerable.

title: A Midsummer's Nice Dreams
subtitle: After Tommy Chong walks away from the Cheech & Chong reunion tour, Homer goes on the road as his replacement. Meanwhile, Marge tries to help the cat lady with her hoarding problem.

title: Love Is a Many Strangled Thing
subtitle: The tables are turned for Homer and Bart after a therapist cures Homer of his violent tendencies toward the boy.

title: The Great Simpsina
subtitle: The family is greeted by folk singer Ewell Freestone when they visit a peach farm, but when Marge goes overboard with peach-inspired dishes, Lisa and Bart try to get rid of the unwanted fruit. Later, Lisa becomes a magician's apprentice to the legendary Great Raymondo who helps her develop her craft, but a schoolgirl crush clouds her judgment when she is coaxed into revealing the Great Raymondo's most famous magic trick to his phony archnemesis. But when the rival magician's act takes a risky turn, the Great Raymondo has one last trick up his sleeve and stages showdown with Ricky Jay, Penn & Teller and David Copperfield , showing them why he is the master of the craft.

title: The Real Housewives of Fat Tony
subtitle: Selma falls in love with and marries Fat Tony, and Lisa discovers that Bart has a skill for finding truffles.

title: Homer Scissorhands
subtitle: Homer opens his own salon after he discovers that he has skills as a hair stylist, and Lisa becomes suspicious after Millhouse gets a 5th grade girlfriend.

title: 500 Keys
subtitle: While Homer takes the Duff Blimp for a joyride, Lisa discovers a secret room in the basement of Sprinfield Elementary School.

title: The Ned-Liest Catch
subtitle: When Krabbapple gets suspended and put into detention after hurting Bart, Bart tries to break her out, but it ends that Flanders is the one that saves her life. But soon, Ned figures out that Edna has also dated other men such as Homer, Skinner Comic Book Guy and Aerosmith drummer Joey Kramer.

title: The Falcon and the D'Ohman
subtitle: Homer tries to befriend the new security guard at the nuclear power plant, who for some unknown reason isn't interested and keeps having flashbacks to his violent past as a government agent.

title: Bart Stops to Smell the Roosevelts
subtitle: Superintendant Chalmers gets fired after using unconventional methods to teach Bart and his friends about Teddy Roosevelt, so the boys take over Springfield Elementary until he gets his old job back.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXII
subtitle: Homer becomes paraplegic after a spider bite, Flanders becomes a vengeful killer after 'God' instructs him to kill the wicked, and Bart and Milhouse go undercover in an alien society.

title: Replaceable You
subtitle: Homer is betrayed by his new assistant at work and winds up working for her, and Bart and Martin create a science project that brings joy to the seniors at the Springfield Retirement Castle.

title: The Food Wife
subtitle: Homer is worried that he is no longer the cool parent after Marge, Bart, and Lisa become foodies.

title: The Book Job
subtitle: Homer and Bart put together a team to author the next successful tween novel franchise and make a million dollars, but discover that they need Lisa's help to pull it off.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
subtitle: Homer gets promoted to accounts manager at the nuclear power plant, but soon learns the job robs you of your soul. Meanwhile, Lisa introduces Bart to "Little Women."

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
subtitle: Krusty the Clown is stuck in a rut when the television network pulls his show from the air and his talent agency drops him as a client. But when the Simpsons introduce him to seasoned agent Annie, they are surprised to learn that Annie was Krusty's very first agent. Despite their rocky relationship, Annie is convinced to re-sign Krusty and craft his career comeback. But when Krusty's retro comedy show reboot is deemed a critical success, Krusty must decide to stay with his agent or side with the network executives.

title: Holidays of Future Passed
subtitle: Thirty years in the future the Simpsons get together for Christmas. Bart and Lisa are struggling as parents to connect with their children.

title: Politically Inept, with Homer Simpson
subtitle: Homer becomes the host of a popular political talk show, starts an "everyman" movement in Springfield, and ends up hand-picking Ted Nugent as the Republican nominee for president.

title: The D'oh-cial Network
subtitle: Lisa creates an online social network that becomes a Springfield obsession, but later becomes a victim of user backlash.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
subtitle: While Bart tries to regain Milhouse's friendship, Moe's bar cleaning rag tells his unlikely story of how he got to where he is today.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
subtitle: Lisa falls for an adventurous, Hemingway-esque young boy, while Bart and Millhouse set out to bust all the myths that surround Springfield Elementary School.

title: At Long Last Leave
subtitle: The town votes to kick the Simpsons out of Springfield, so they decide to move to the Outlands.

title: Exit Through the Kwik-E-Mart
subtitle: Bart becomes an urban vandal and decides to use Homer as his inspiration, while Apu hits hard times when a new trendy market takes all the Kwik-E-Mart customers.

title: How I Wet Your Mother
subtitle: The family break into Homer's dreams Inception-style after he begins wetting the bed.

title: Them, Robot
subtitle: Mr. Burns replaces all of the nuclear plant employees with robots--except for Homer, who stays along to supervise the robots and serve as a human scapegoat.

title: Beware My Cheating Bart
subtitle: Jimbo's girlfriend cheats on Jimbo with Bart, and Homer uses his new treadmill to catch up on a TV series about plane crash victims stranded on an island.

title: A Totally Fun Thing Bart Will Never Do Again
subtitle: Bart gets the family to take the cruise vacation of his dreams, and then launches a fiendish plot to ensure that it goes on forever.

title: The Spy Who Learned Me
subtitle: Homer uses his paid sick leave to improve his marriage, with the help of his imaginary friend, super-spy Stradivarius Cain. Meanwhile, Bart gets revenge on Nelson for stealing everyone's lunch money.

title: Ned 'N Edna's Blend Agenda
subtitle: After Ned and Edna announce publicly that they were secretly married, the two clash over how to raise Rod and Todd.

title: Lisa Goes Gaga
subtitle: After a desperate attempt by Lisa to become more popular backfires, Lady Gaga shows up in Springfield to help her with her self-esteem.

title: Moonshine River
subtitle: The Simpsons go back to New York City so that Bart can find his old girlfriend Mary Spuckler. Meanwhile, Lisa and Marge spend the trip trying to take in New York culture on the cheap.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIII
subtitle: A black hole threatens to swallow Springfield, Homer tries to find the source of paranormal activity, and a "Back to the Future" parody in which Bart keeps Marge from marrying Homer.

title: Adventures in Baby-Getting
subtitle: Marge decides that she wants another baby, but Homer doesn't want one. Meanwhile, Bart tries to figure out where Lisa is secretly going after school.

title: Gone Abie Gone
subtitle: Homer invests Lisa's college fund on an online poker site. Meanwhile Abe disappears from the Springfield Retirement Castle.

title: Penny-Wiseguys
subtitle: Fat Tony has to serve jury duty, and his clerk, Dan, must run the mafia while he's gone. Meanwhile, Lisa considers making a disgusting change to her diet.

title: A Tree Grows in Springfield
subtitle: Homer becomes addicted to his new tablet computer. But when it is destroyed Homer becomes despondent, until he finds and provides hope for Springfield in the most unlikely place.

title: The Day the Earth Stood Cool
subtitle: Homer befriends a hipster and invites his family to move in next door. However, their friendship soon sours as Springfield is transformed into a haven for "coolness."

title: To Cur with Love
subtitle: When Homer shows no remorse over almost losing Santa's Little Helper, Grandpa tells everyone the story of Homer's childhood dog.

title: Homer Goes to Prep School
subtitle: Homer joins the "Springfield Preppers," an off-the-grid survivalist group whose leader has set up a top-secret retreat outside of town to prepare for the end of the world.

title: A Test Before Trying
subtitle: The fate of Springfield Elementary rests on Bart and his test scores, and Homer finds way to make money with his own parking meter.

title: Changing of the Guardian
subtitle: Homer and Marge find the perfect young couple and ask them to be the guardians for the kids in case something happens to them.

title: Love Is a Many Splintered Thing
subtitle: Mary Spuckler returns to Springfield and begins a relationship with Bart. However, Bart treats her with disrespect.

title: Hardly Kirk-ing
subtitle: Bart poses Millhouse as his father so that they can do adult activities, and Homer becomes skilled at finding lost objects thanks to Highlights magazine.

title: Gorgeous Grampa
subtitle: Homer's obsession with the TV show "Storage Battles" leads the family to discover Grampa's past identity as "Gorgeous Godfrey," the most feared, villainous man in pro-wrestling history

title: Black-Eyed, Please
subtitle: Ned gets fed up with Homer and punches him in the eye, and Lisa is a bullying victim from her new substitute teacher.

title: Dark Knight Court
subtitle: When Bart is accused of a prank he says he didn't commit, Lisa is forced to defend him in youth court, with former attorney general Janet Reno serving as judge.

title: What Animated Women Want
subtitle: Homer contemplates his next move after getting in the doghouse with Marge, while Millhouse's new Stanley Kowalski-inspired persona makes him suddenly attractive to Lisa.

title: Pulpit Friction
subtitle: Springfield gets a bedbug scare, the new assistant pastor at church appoints Homer as a deacon, and Marge loses her wedding dress.

title: Whiskey Business
subtitle: A new makeover could put Moe in a position to make big money, Bart fails at his job of taking care of Grandpa, and Lisa fights the shameless exploitation of Bleeding Gums Murphy's likeness.

title: The Fabulous Faker Boy
subtitle: Bart takes piano lessons from a cute Russian girl, Marge tries to teach the girl's father how to drive, and Homer loses the last of his hair.

title: The Saga of Carl
subtitle: Homer, Moe, Lenny and Carl win the lottery, but Carl steals the ticket and leaves with the money for Iceland.

title: Dangers on a Train
subtitle: When Marge tries to buy Homer snack cakes for their anniversary, she winds up meeting a married man who shares a common love of British television.

title: Homerland
subtitle: Homer returns from a nuclear power convention a changed man, and Lisa begins to suspect that he has become a domestic terrorist.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
subtitle: The scariest Simpsons Halloween show yet, featuring an opening by Guillermo Del Toro.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
subtitle: While attending a funeral, Homer, Marge, Mr. Burns, and Kent Brockman recall a past regret and try to find a way to rectify the situation.

title: YOLO
subtitle: Homer is stunned to learn he'll only live once. A pen pal from his youth helps him live that life to its fullest. Meanwhile Springfield Elementary institutes an honor code.

title: Labor Pains
subtitle: Homer helps take care of a child that he delivered in an elevator, and Lisa tries to organize the Springfield Atoms cheerleaders against the team's greedy owner.

title: The Kid Is All Right
subtitle: Lisa is distressed when she discovers that her new friend is a Republican, and they wind up running against each other as Springfield Elementary's second grade representative.

title: Yellow Subterfuge
subtitle: Principal Skinner promises the students that the best-behaved can take a ride in a submarine. Bart believes his past indiscretions will be forgotten. Lisa tries to help Krusty by suggesting him to sell the foreign rights to his shows.

title: White Christmas Blues
subtitle: When a sudden tourist spike means that the family cannot afford Christmas, the Simpsons open up their house to boarders.

title: Steal This Episode
subtitle: Fed up with the high price of Hollywood films, Homer begins screening pirated movies in his backyard, but is busted by the FBI after Marge turns him in.

title: Married to the Blob
subtitle: Comic Book Guy seeks romantic advice from Homer when he falls for a Japanese woman who's interested in manga.

title: Specs and the City
subtitle: Mr. Burns' Christmas present to his employees, a pair of augmented reality glasses, places a strain on Homer and Marge's relationship. Meanwhile, Bart wrestles with giving a Valentine's Day card to Nelson.

title: Diggs
subtitle: Bart becomes friends with a schoolmate who enjoys falconry, but turns out to be mentally disturbed.

title: The Man Who Grew Too Much
subtitle: Lisa becomes friends with Sideshow Bob, who now has a new job working with genetically-altered foods. Meanwhile, Marge becomes frustrated teaching abstinence for the church.

title: The Winter of His Content
subtitle: When Abe and two of his friends move in with the Simpsons after the Springfield Retirement Castle closes, Homer begins to embrace their lifestyle. Meanwhile, Nelson initiates Bart into the bully group after coming to his defense.

title: The War of Art
subtitle: The friendship between the Simpsons and the Van Houtens is challenged when a painting the Simpsons buy from the Van Houtens' yard sale is discovered to be extremely valuable.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
subtitle: Homer becomes a referee for the World Cup and finds himself tested by bribers when the Simpsons travel to Brazil.

title: Luca$
subtitle: Marge becomes worried when Lisa starts dating a competitive eater-in-training, while Bart receives gifts from Snake Jailbird for helping him out.

title: Days of Future Future
subtitle: Thirty years into the future, Bart is having trouble dealing with his divorce, Lisa is struggling with her marriage to Milhouse, and Marge is finally fed up after burying yet another Homer clone.

title: What to Expect When Bart's Expecting
subtitle: Bart becomes a savior to Springfield couples trying to conceive when he inadvertently uses voodoo to get his art teacher pregnant.

title: Brick Like Me
subtitle: The Lego version of Homer begins to suspect that his entire Lego world is not real when a toy triggers a flashback to an alternate reality.

title: Pay Pal
subtitle: When Homer ruins his and Marge's chances of making a new couple friend, Marge decides to concentrate on finding a friend for Lisa. However, Lisa suddenly makes a new friend on her own.

title: The Yellow Badge of Cowardge
subtitle: Bart wins the annual "last day of school" race - with a little help from Nelson - and Homer attempts to bring back 4th of July fireworks, which have been canceled due to low budget cuts.

title: Clown in the Dumps
subtitle: Krusty has a crisis of conscience and retires from show business after his father dies before ever approving of his career. Meanwhile, Lisa becomes worried about Homer's health and life expectancy.

title: The Wreck of the Relationship
subtitle: Homer and Bart turn to the open seas to improve their relationship, and Marge becomes a trash talking victim after she drafts Homer's fantasy football team.

title: Super Franchise Me
subtitle: Marge opens a sandwich franchise store after her sandwiches become a huge hit at Springfield Elementary. But running day-to-day at the store proves challenging, especially when the same franchise opens another location across the street.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXV
subtitle: The 25th annual 'Simpsons' Halloween special includes an alternate dimension, a "Clockwork Orange"-style gang led by Moe and a visit from the Tracey Ullman-era Simpsons.

title: Opposites A-Frack
subtitle: An Assemblywoman brought in by Lisa to stop Mr. Burns' fracking operation ends up falling for him as much as he does for her.

title: Simpsorama
subtitle: The Simpsons meet the Planet Express crew, who have come to Springfield in the present to stop them from destroying the future.

title: Blazed and Confused
subtitle: Bart tricks his family into a camping trip at a strange event known as "Blazing Guy" so that he can get revenge on his sadistic new fourth grade teacher.

title: Covercraft
subtitle: Homer forms a cover band with other dads in town when he takes up bass guitar to deal with a mid-life crisis, but the band's modest success is soon overwhelmed by Apu's breakout potential.

title: I Won't Be Home for Christmas
subtitle: Marge kicks Homer out of the house for Christmas after he consoles Moe on Christmas Eve instead of going home.

title: The Man Who Came to Be Dinner
subtitle: An amusement park ride takes the Simpsons to the home planet of Kang and Kodos.

title: Bart's New Friend
subtitle: Homer is hypnotized into believing he's ten years old and ends up stuck in his new age when the hypnotist gets arrested, so he bonds with Bart and refuses to take back the responsibilities of adulthood.

title: The Musk Who Fell to Earth
subtitle: Inventor Elon Musk comes to Springfield, and Homer inspires him with a new idea that could revolutionize Springfield, but winds up costing Mr. Burns a ton of money.

title: Walking Big & Tall
subtitle: Marge tries to get Homer to lose weight. But instead, he finds a support group that encourages him to embrace his largeness.

title: My Fare Lady
subtitle: Marge gets a job as a driver for a transportation app service, while Moe is forced to work as a janitor at the nuclear plant after Homer causes the bar to go bankrupt.

title: The Princess Guide
subtitle: Moe falls in love with a Nigerian princess whose father is working out a uranium deal with Mr. Burns.

title: Sky Police
subtitle: The congregation, led by Marge, is forced to resort to gambling in order to collect money to fix the church, which Chief Wiggum destroyed with a jet pack he received by mistake.

title: Waiting for Duffman
subtitle: After "Duffman" retires, Homer wins a reality competition to become his replacement. But his contract states that he cannot drink beer, which gives him a new perspective on alcohol.

title: Peeping Mom
subtitle: Marge decides to follow Bart everywhere until he confesses to being involved in a bulldozer crash. Meanwhile, Homer ignores Santa's Little Helper when Ned gets a new dog.

title: The Kids Are All Fight
subtitle: The story of Bart and Lisa's rivalry is told when Homer finds an old film strip.

title: Let's Go Fly a Coot
subtitle: Bart takes up smoking e-cigarettes to impress Milhouse's cousin Annika while the rest of the family learns about Grampa's days in the Air Force.

title: Bull-E
subtitle: Bart gets bullied at a school dance, so Marge gets an anti-bullying law passed, which results in Homer being put in therapy for bullying Ned.

title: Mathlete's Feat
subtitle: Groundskeeper Willie becomes the coach of the mathletes, Lisa and other kids from Springfield Elementary compete against Waverly Hills Elementary.

title: Every Man's Dream
subtitle: Marge decides it's finally time to separate from Homer, and quickly moves on with her life. Homer is initially devastated, but soon stumbles into a romance with a younger woman.

title: 'Cue Detective
subtitle: A celebrity television chef challenges Homer to a barbecue cook-off. But before the competition, Homer's new, prized barbecue grill is stolen.

title: Puffless
subtitle: Patty and Selma try to quit smoking, but Patty moves in with the Simpsons when Selma takes it up again. Meanwhile, Maggie goes on an adventure with some local creatures.

title: Halloween of Horror
subtitle: The Simpsons are proud to be the most festively decorated house on the block. But when Lisa is traumatized at Krustyland Horror Night, she feels she cannot handle Halloween anymore.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXVI
subtitle: Sideshow Bob finally kills Bart. Homerzilla rises when he doesn't get his daily doughnut. Bart, Lisa, and Milhouse fall into a cave filled with radioactive chemicals from the power plant.

title: Friend with Benefit
subtitle: Lisa makes a new friend at school - Harper, who happens to be super-rich, while Homer makes friends with Harper's dad and sets out to continue living the good life when Lisa decides to end the friendship.

title: Lisa with an "S"
subtitle: Broadway legend Laney Fontaine transforms Lisa into a show-biz kid after Homer loses her chance at band camp.

title: Paths of Glory
subtitle: Lisa tries to restore the reputation of a forgotten Springfield female inventor, while Bart takes full advantage of his parents belief that he is a sociopath.

title: Barthood
subtitle: A tale of Bart's journey from youth to adulthood, where he is constantly in search of approval from his father and in the shadow of his more-successful younger sister.

title: The Girl Code
subtitle: When Homer loses his job due to Marge's social media post, he begins working as a dishwasher at a Greek restaurant. Meanwhile, Lisa creates an app that can predict the effect any post on social media will have.

title: Teenage Mutant Milk-Caused Hurdles
subtitle: Bart and Principal Skinner battle over the affection of Bart's new teacher, and a new milk-based product that Homer buys from the Kwik-E-Mart causes big changes in Bart and Lisa.

title: Much Apu About Something
subtitle: Apu's nephew makes big changes when he takes over the Kwik-E-Mart business, and Bart decides that he's through with being bad after his latest prank spirals out of control.

title: Love Is in the N2-O2-Ar-CO2-Ne-He-CH4
subtitle: Professor Frink's new invention turns him into a ladies' man, while a new pill at the Springfield Retirement Castle causes Grandpa to hallucinate back to his happiest moments.

title: Gal of Constant Sorrow
subtitle: Lisa tries to launch the career of a homeless Appalachian folk singer, but Bart warns her that she will just let her down. Meanwhile, Homer tries to rescue the cat, who is trapped in the walls of the house.

title: Lisa the Veterinarian
subtitle: Lisa takes a job as veterinarian's assistant, but soon lets the responsibilities of the job get to her head. Meanwhile, Marge decides to take a job as a crime scene cleaner.

title: The Marge-ian Chronicles
subtitle: Lisa signs up for an opportunity to be part of a mission to colonize Mars in ten years, and Homer's strategy to use reverse psychology to talk her out of it backfires.

title: The Burns Cage
subtitle: Homer tries to raise Smithers' spirits by finding him a man, and Lisa gets the lead in the school production of "Casablanca" alongside a new male student, sparking Millhouse's jealousy.

title: How Lisa Got Her Marge Back
subtitle: After Lisa overhears Marge say that she doesn't like Lisa's jazz music, Marge takes Lisa on a trip to Capitol City to regain her friendship. Meanwhile, Bart uses Maggie as his new partner in crime for his practical jokes.

title: Fland Canyon
subtitle: Maggie will not go to sleep, so Homer tells her a bedtime story about when the Simpsons and the Flanders went to the Grand Canyon together.

title: To Courier with Love
subtitle: After promising Marge the trip of a lifetime, Homer makes a deal with a travel agent to be a courier of a top-secret briefcase in exchange for a discounted family vacation to Paris.

title: Simprovised
subtitle: While trying to overcome a fear of public speaking, Homer creates an improv comedy troupe; Marge rebuilds Bart's treehouse.

title: Orange Is the New Yellow
subtitle: Marge lets Bart go to the park alone because he's too irritating, then she ends up getting arrested for leaving him unsupervised.

title: Monty Burns' Fleeing Circus
subtitle: Mr. Burns puts on a variety show at the Springfield Bowl.

title: Friends and Family
subtitle: Homer finds a new friend in a woman who acts just like him when Mr. Burns hires the other Simpsons as his live-in virtual reality family.

title: The Town
subtitle: Homer takes the family on a "hate-cation" to Boston after he catches Bart rooting for a rival football team.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXVII
subtitle: The children of Springfield fight to the death, Hunger Games style; Lisa's imaginary friend kills her real friends; Moe recruits Bart into his group of covert barfly agents.

title: Trust But Clarify
subtitle: Bart and Lisa investigate Krusty's new candy; Marge helps Homer dress for a promotion; Kent Brockman struggles with the changing media world.

title: There Will Be Buds
subtitle: Homer coaches the kids' lacrosse team with Kirk Van Houten, who disappears before the championship game, after Homer rants about him being a loser.

title: Havana Wild Weekend
subtitle: The Simpsons go to Cuba to get Grampa cheap medical care when the Retirement Castle and V.A. hospital are unable to solve his health problems.

title: Dad Behavior
subtitle: Homer discovers an app that makes his life easier, while Grampa learns that he'll be a father again.

title: The Last Traction Hero
subtitle: Homer is placed in a cast following a workplace accident, leading Marge to receive romance from an unexpected source; Lisa attempts to keep the peace as bus monitor.

title: The Nightmare After Krustmas
subtitle: Krusty and his daughter spend Christmas with the Simpsons; Reverend Lovejoy seeks converts to boost attendance at church; A Christmas toy scares Maggie.

title: Pork and Burns
subtitle: A Japanese book on minimalism inspires Marge to adapt to a new way of living, so the Simpsons have to part with items that no longer bring them joy.

title: The Great Phatsby
subtitle: Mr Burns tries to relive his glory days, and crosses paths with a mysterious music mogul.

title: The Great Phatsby: Part 2
subtitle: Mr Burns tries to relive his glory days, and crosses paths with a mysterious music mogul.

title: Fatzcarraldo
subtitle: When all the fast food restaurants in Springfield become healthy, Homer turns to the last bastion of greasy food for comfort; Lisa must find a good news story when her school radio station is in jeopardy.

title: The Cad and the Hat
subtitle: Bart ruins Lisa's perfect day out of jealousy and becomes haunted by the manifestation of his guilty conscious. Homer is revealed to be a master chess player which helps him bond with his competitive dad.

title: Kamp Krustier
subtitle: Bart and Lisa return home following a traumatic incident at Kamp Krusty, putting an end to Homer and Marge's sexual encounters.

title: 22 for 30
subtitle: A mocumentary about how Bart became a star basketball player at Springfield Elementary only to fall prey to fame, his own ego and the schemes of mobster Fat Tony.

title: A Father's Watch
subtitle: As Homer and Marge try a different parenting style on the hellraising Bart, Grampa gives him a special watch that becomes Bart's moral center. But Bart loses it and tries everything to get it back.

title: The Caper Chase
subtitle: Mr. Burns opens his own for-profit university, hiring the completely unqualified Homer as a professor, only to lose him to a mad scientist.

title: Looking for Mr. Goodbart
subtitle: Bart bonds with Skinner's mother over their mutual dislike of Skinner and realizes that he could make a bundle by befriending other lonely and disgruntled grandmothers of Springfield for money.

title: Moho House
subtitle: Mr. Burns makes a bet with his old friend that nothing can break Homer and Marge apart. But that's where Moe comes in.

title: Dogtown
subtitle: After a successful animal rights campaign, all dogs in Springfield are allowed to go where they want and do what they want. Pack mentality quickly kicks in and the dogs of Springfield assert their dominance by threatening the people.

title: The Serfsons
subtitle: In a medieval world, Lisa is forced to use illegal magic when Marge's mother is turned into an Ice Walker.

title: Springfield Splendor
subtitle: Lisa's sad experience is adapted into a graphic novel, which becomes a Broadway show.

title: Whistler's Father
subtitle: Homer launches Maggie's baby-celebrity career with her whistling talent; Marge is hired to style Fat Tony's brothel.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXVIII
subtitle: Maggie gets possessed by a demon; Lisa discovers a creepy/perfect version of her family in an alternative universe; Homer cannibalizes himself.

title: Grampy Can Ya Hear Me
subtitle: Grampa gets a hearing aid and finally hears what everyone has been saying about him.

title: The Old Blue Mayor She Ain't What She Used To Be
subtitle: Marge runs for mayor and uses Homer as the butt of her jokes to gain public support.

title: Singin' in the Lane
subtitle: Homer gets his old bowling team back together and they wind up competing with arrogant millionaires.

title: Mr. Lisa's Opus
subtitle: In the future, Lisa writes a college application essay to Harvard and recalls disappointing past birthdays that helped shape her.

title: Gone Boy
subtitle: When Bart goes missing, the town puts together a search party to find him.

title: Haw-Haw Land
subtitle: Lisa falls for a crooning jazz pianist named Brendan; Bart discovers he has an affinity for chemistry.

title: Frink Gets Testy
subtitle: Mr. Burns builds a doomsday ark after he believes the world is ending; Professor Frink is tasked with determining who is worth saving.

title: Homer is Where the Art Isn't
subtitle: Homer is accused of stealing a multimillion-dollar painting and only freelance insurance investigator Manacek can prove his innocence or guilt.

title: 3 Scenes Plus a Tag from a Marriage
subtitle: Homer and Marge tell the story of how they went from loving life without kids to being miserable parents.

title: Fears of a Clown
subtitle: Bart goes to prankster rehab after a clown-mask prank terrifies the town and ruins Krusty's career causing him to give up comedy and try serious drama.

title: No Good Read Goes Unpunished
subtitle: Marge forces everyone to give up their electronics and go to the book store in an effort to bring the family together.

title: King Leer
subtitle: Homer and Marge attempt to reunite Moe with his troubled family.

title: Lisa Gets the Blues
subtitle: The Simpsons' flight to Gainesville gets re-routed to New Orleans, where Lisa must regain her confidence as a jazz musician.

title: Forgive and Regret
subtitle: On his deathbed, Grampa makes a confession to Homer about the notes from Homer's mother that got lost when she left. This angers Homer to the point of refusing to reconcile with Abe after he miraculously recovers.

title: Left Behind
subtitle: Homer gets Flanders a job at the power plant; Marge feels there's no spark left in their marriage.

title: Throw Grampa from the Dane
subtitle: The Simpsons go to Denmark so Grampa can benefit from its free health-care system.

title: Flanders' Ladder
subtitle: When Bart falls into a coma after he is struck by lightning, he is visited by ghosts seeking closure.

title: Bart's Not Dead
subtitle: Bart ends up in the hospital after taking a dare and lies about going to heaven to cover it up, but Homer takes a deal with Christian producers to make a movie about it.

title: Heartbreak Hotel
subtitle: Marge and Homer travel to a tropical island and go on Marge's favorite reality competition program to win a million dollars.

title: My Way or the Highway to Heaven
subtitle: While God and St. Peter discuss who will get into heaven, the citizens of Springfield recall divine encounters.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIX
subtitle: Homer wins an oyster-eating contest against the mythical Cthulhu, Springfield is overrun by plant body-snatchers, Lisa finally snaps and Mr. Burns opens a retirement home with some Jurassic upgrades.

title: Baby You Can't Drive My Car
subtitle: A self-driving car company comes to Springfield, poaching all of the power plant employees with their fun work environment.

title: From Russia Without Love
subtitle: Bart, Nelson and Milhouse get a mail-order bride for Moe as a hardcore prank.

title: Werking Mom
subtitle: In search of a job, Marge gets one selling plastic food storage containers - as a drag queen; Lisa tries to make the world better.

title: Krusty the Clown
subtitle: Krusty hides out at a circus after he nearly kills Homer, who becomes a TV recapper and gives him a bad grade.

title: Daddicus Finch
subtitle: Bart feels neglected when Homer and Lisa bond over To Kill a Mockingbird and start spending quality time together, so Marge attempts to help Homer balance attention between the kids.

title: 'Tis the 30th Season
subtitle: Marge is determined to fix Christmas following a failed Black Friday shopping spree, but Homer and the kids surprise her with a vacation in Florida.

title: Mad About the Toy
subtitle: Motivated by a PTSD episode Grampa had while babysitting the kids, the Simpsons take a journey to Grampa's past as a post-WW2 toy model for plastic army men, and Abe finally faces his on confused sexuality.

title: The Girl on the Bus
subtitle: Lisa tries to live a double life when she makes a new friend and gets a taste of what it would be like to live with a more cultured family.

title: I'm Dancing as Fat as I Can
subtitle: Homer tries to make amends for binging his and Marge's favorite show without her; Bart prepares for "Krusty's Holiday Trample".

title: The Clown Stays in the Picture
subtitle: On Marc Maron's podcast, Krusty reveals the untold story of his past movie project, The Sands of Space. Hearing the podcast, Bart and Lisa learn their parents were production assistants on the movie in the early days of their relationship.

title: 101 Mitigations
subtitle: Homer steals Comic Book Guy's car and must either prove his innocence in court or reconcile with him.

title: I Want You (She's So Heavy)
subtitle: When a romantic night ends in injury for Homer and Marge, Lisa turns to an unlikely source to fix their strained relationship.

title: E My Sports
subtitle: Homer discovers a passion for coaching Bart in video game competitions; Lisa's plan to bring Homer back to reality creates chaos.

title: Bart vs. Itchy & Scratchy
subtitle: Bart's friends start a boys rights activist group to protest Krusty's all-female reboot of Itchy and Scratchy. When they catch Bart enjoying it, they kick him out, so he joins Bossy Riot, a militant feminist gang of sixth-grade girls.

title: Girl's in the Band
subtitle: Homer works extra shifts at the plant so Lisa can play in the Capitol City Youth Philharmonic.

title: I'm Just a Girl Who Can't Say D'oh
subtitle: Marge becomes Director of Springfield's local theater, armed with Lisa's script resembling "Hamilton"; Homer joins a baby class with Maggie, and takes a liking to supervisor Chloe.

title: D'oh Canada
subtitle: Lisa is mistakenly given political asylum in Canada during a family trip to Niagara Falls.

title: Woo-Hoo Dunnit?
subtitle: The documentary crime series "Dateline: Springfield" goes in-depth to solve the case of Lisa's missing college fund.

title: Crystal Blue-Haired Persuasion
subtitle: Marge starts a business selling healing crystals and other New Age products to the naive mothers of Springfield when Homer's job cuts children's health-care benefits, leading Marge to use the crystals as a cheaper solution for Bart's ADD.

title: The Winter of Our Monetized Content
subtitle: Bart and Homer become social media celebrities when a video of them fighting goes viral; Lisa fights the school's new industrialized detention system.

title: Go Big or Go Homer
subtitle: Homer inspires a 35-year-old millennial who idolizes him to start his own business, which leads the mob to chase both of them.

title: The Fat Blue Line
subtitle: When the wrong man is arrested for pickpocketing Springfield during the San Castellaneta street festival, Chief Wiggum sets out to catch the real criminal.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXX
subtitle: The 30th Treehouse of Horror features a demon Maggie, a mission to rescue Milhouse from another dimension, dead-Homer's spirit trying on some new bodies for size and Selma finally finding love in an unlikely place - the alien in the basement.

title: Gorillas on the Mast
subtitle: After visiting Aquatraz Water Park, Lisa and Bart set out to free from captivity the most vicious animals in Springfield. Homer fulfills a lifelong dream and buys a boat, only to realize how much boat ownership sucks.

title: Marge the Lumberjill
subtitle: Marge becomes a competitive lumberjack and goes on a month-long retreat to Portland with her trainer, whom Homer fears will take his wife away from him.

title: Livin la Pura Vida
subtitle: The Simpsons join other Springfield families on the Van Houtens' annual trip to Costa Rica, where Homer befriends Patty's new girlfriend and Lisa discovers how the Van Houtens are able to afford this trip every year.

title: Thanksgiving of Horror
subtitle: The Simpsons face various Thanksgiving nightmares, including the first Thanksgiving, an A.I. mishap and a dangerous space mission complicated by a sentient cranberry sauce.

title: Todd, Todd, Why Hast Thou Forsaken Me?
subtitle: Todd blames God for his mother's death and rejects his faith, so Ned sends him to live with the Simpsons, hoping they can scare him into believing in God again.

title: Bobby, It's Cold Outside
subtitle: Sideshow Bob gets the role of Santa Claus at Santa's Village amusement park. Meanwhile, someone is stealing all the Christmas packages off people's front porches.

title: Hail to the Teeth
subtitle: Homer and Marge attend Artie Ziff's wedding and become quite uncomfortable when they realize that his bride-to-be is a clone of Marge.

title: The Miseducation of Lisa Simpson
subtitle: The sea captain finds treasure for which he's been searching for 40 years, but City Hall claims it since it was in city limits. Marge convinces the townspeople to use the windfall to build a STEM school. Homer crusades against automation.

title: Frinkcoin
subtitle: Professor Frink invents a cryptocurrency that makes him the richest man in Springfield, a title Mr. Burns has no intention of giving up.

title: Bart the Bad Guy
subtitle: Bart uses spoilers for a superhero movie he saw to get what he wants, but two movie executives will stop at nothing to keep his knowledge secret.

title: Screenless
subtitle: Marge implements a limit on screen time for the whole family, only to realize she's the one addicted to screens.

title: Better Off Ned
subtitle: Envious of Bart's bond with Ned, Homer mentors Nelson in retaliation, but an act of heroism helps Homer to regain Bart's respect.

title: Highway to Well
subtitle: Marge gets a job at an upscale cannabis dispensary leading Homer to open a competing business that replicates the scuzzy days of scoring weed from an old-school pot connection.

title: The Incredible Lightness of Being a Baby
subtitle: Maggie reunites with baby Hudson, but Marge isn't too crazy about his mom. Homer befriends Cletus Spuckler who recently discovered a vast underground reserve of helium gas on his property, attracting unwanted attention from Mr. Burns.

title: Warrin' Priests: Part 1
subtitle: Reverend Lovejoy investigates the mysterious past of a new priest who's come to town and shaken things up at church.

title: Warrin' Priests: Part 2
subtitle: In Michigan, Reverend Lovejoy learns the true reason why Bode came to Springfield and the congregation must decide whether to banish their new priest.

title: The Hateful Eight-Year-Olds
subtitle: Lisa joins a group of rich girls when she makes a friend who loves horses; Homer takes Marge on a romantic cruise.

title: The Way of the Dog
subtitle: The Simpsons explore the tragic past of Santa's Little Helper when he bites Marge.

title: Undercover Burns
subtitle: Mr. Burns goes undercover at the power plant as an employee named Fred and befriends Homer and the gang, but a jealous Smithers plots to bring the old Burns back.

title: I, Carumbus
subtitle: At a museum exhibit of Ancient Rome, Marge and Homer imagine themselves in Rome where Homer is more ambitious.

title: Now Museum, Now You Don't
subtitle: Lisa stays home from school and fantasizes about the history of Western art.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXXI
subtitle: The 31st annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Pixar and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and a ninth birthday Lisa just can't get over.

title: The 7 Beer Itch
subtitle: Homer is tempted by a British femme fatale while Marge and the kids are on a seaside vacation.

title: Podcast News
subtitle: Grampa is accused of a crime, while Kent Brockman questions his career.

title: Three Dreams Denied
subtitle: Bart becomes a voice over actor, Comic Book Guy is humiliated at Comic-Con and Lisa is set up for a fall.

title: The Road to Cincinnati
subtitle: Skinner and Chalmers take an 800-mile car ride to an administrator's convention in Cincinnati.

title: Sorry Not Sorry
subtitle: Lisa calls Ms. Hoover a hack and refuses to apologize, then learns her private pain.

title: A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
subtitle: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

title: The Dad-Feelings Limited
subtitle: The origin story of Comic Book Guy is revealed as he and Kumiko debate having a baby.

title: Diary Queen
subtitle: Bart learns a surprising secret when he finds Mrs. Krabappel's diary at a yard sale, while Lisa discovers an even bigger surprise.

title: Wad Goals
subtitle: Bart becomes a successful caddie, but Marge thinks it may ruin his character.

title: Yokel Hero
subtitle: Cletus becomes a singing sensation and ruins everything when he turns on his fans, while Homer becomes a new man.

title: Do Pizza Bots Dream of Electric Guitars
subtitle: Homer tries to reunite a mechanical band from his youth, but J.J. Abrams beats him to it.

title: Manger Things
subtitle: A secret from Flanders' past and a never-before-seen room in the Simpson home are revealed.

title: Uncut Femmes
subtitle: Sarah Wiggum is more than she seems; Marge participates in a jewel heist.

title: Burger Kings
subtitle: Mr. Burns joins the plant-based burger business, convincing Lisa that he's changed for the better.

title: Panic on the Streets of Springfield
subtitle: Lisa's imaginary friend is a depressed British singer from the 1980s; Homer becomes a truck guy.

title: Mother and Child Reunion
subtitle: In the future, Lisa makes a shocking college decision that hurts Marge, leading to a surprising place.

title: The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.
subtitle: A British secret agent comes to Springfield to find a Russian spy.

title: The Last Barfighter
subtitle: A secret society of bartenders seeks revenge on Homer and his friends when Moe breaks their most sacred rule.

title: The Star of the Backstage
subtitle: Marge stages a revival of a musical from high school, but her pleasant memories are threatened by the return of her old rival.

title: Bart's in Jail!
subtitle: When Grandpa falls victim to a phone scam, the Simpsons set out to get his money back.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXXII
subtitle: The 32nd annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a spoof of "Parasite" and a segment where Bambi gets his revenge.

title: The Wayz We Were
subtitle: Moe is faced with a difficult choice when Evergreen Terrace develops a traffic problem.

title: Lisa's Belly
subtitle: Lisa reacts to a hurtful word spoken by Marge while Bart gets swole.

title: A Serious Flanders
subtitle: Homer and Ned get sucked into the violent world of prestige TV when a ruthless debt collector comes to Springfield.

title: A Serious Flanders: Part 2
subtitle: Things go from bad to worse for Homer and Ned.

title: Portrait of a Lackey on Fire
subtitle: Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but this new relationship may destroy Springfield.

title: Mothers and Other Strangers
subtitle: In a flashback to his teen years, Homer goes on a road trip with his father to search for his mother.

title: A Made Maggie
subtitle: Fat Tony becomes Maggie's godfather.

title: The Longest Marge
subtitle: Marge battles Mr. Burns for the soul of a brash young football prodigy.

title: Pixelated and Afraid
subtitle: Homer and Marge must push themselves to their limits when they get lost in an icy wilderness.

title: Boyz N the Highlands
subtitle: Bart, Martin and the bullies run for their lives when a weekend in the wilderness takes a dark turn.

title: You Won't Believe What This Episode Is About - Act Three Will Shock You!
subtitle: Homer becomes a pariah when footage of him allegedly leaving Santa's Little Helper in a hot car goes viral.

title: Bart the Cool Kid
subtitle: Homero encabeza una rebelión de padres perdedores contra la amistad entre Bart y un famoso niño influencer.

title: Pretty Whittle Liar
subtitle: Cletus feels betrayed when he learns that Brandine can read.

title: The Sound of Bleeding Gums
subtitle: Lisa meets the son of the late Bleeding Gums Murphy and tries to improve his life.

title: My Octopus and a Teacher
subtitle: Bart has romantic feelings for his new teacher; Lisa befriends an octopus.

title: Girls Just Shauna Have Fun
subtitle: Lisa finds an unlikely mentor in Shauna Chalmers when she joins the high-school marching band; Homer becomes a craft-beer brewer.

title: Marge the Meanie
subtitle: Marge bonds with Bart when she discovers a secret from her past, terrifying Homer.

title: Meat Is Murder
subtitle: Grampa reconnects with an old associate in the hamburger business.

title: Poorhouse Rock
subtitle: Bart finally learns to admire Homer, but a visit from a magical singing janitor changes everything they thought they knew.

title: Habeas Tortoise
subtitle: Tras humillarse en una reunión municipal, Homero busca aceptación en un grupo de Internet a la caza de una tortuga desaparecida y encuentra algo mucho más siniestro.

title: One Angry Lisa
subtitle: A Lisa la llaman para ser jurado, mientras Marge se obsesiona con su bicicleta estática.

title: Lisa the Boy Scout
subtitle: El programa es secuestrado por terroristas cibernéticos.

title: The King of Nice
subtitle: Marge consigue un trabajo como productora de segmentos en el nuevo programa de entrevistas de Krusty, que pronto se da cuenta de que es una pesadilla interminable.

title: Not It
subtitle: El joven Homero y sus amigos son aterrorizados por un payaso asesino en una presentación especial de Treehouse of Horror, una parodia de "It" de Stephen King.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
subtitle: En el 33º especial anual de Halloween, el resentimiento de Marge adopta una forma monstruosa, Lisa intenta salvar el planeta mediante el asesinato y Homer se da cuenta de que no es el hombre que creía ser.

title: From Beer to Paternity
subtitle: Homero y Duffman emprenden un viaje por carretera con Lisa que amenaza con sacar a la luz la mala paternidad de Homer después de que éste se convierta en el héroe de Duffman.

title: Step Brother from the Same Planet
subtitle: Homero se llena de rabia y resentimiento cuando el abuelo se convierte en padrastro del hijo de su novia; Lisa y Bart organizan la fiesta de pijamas definitiva.

title: When Nelson Met Lisa
subtitle: Lisa y Nelson se convierten en una improbable pareja en el futuro.

title: Game Done Changed
subtitle: Bart involucra al director Skinner en su plan para aprovechar un fallo en un juego online; Marge y Maggie descubren el paraíso.

title: Top Goon
subtitle: Moe entrena al equipo de hockey de Bart y recluta a los mejores camorristas del mundo para que enseñen a Nelson el arte del hockey.

title: My Life as a Vlog
subtitle: El ascenso y la caída de la familia Simpson Vlog se cuenta a través de una serie de vídeos recomendados de YouTube.

title: The Many Saints of Springfield
subtitle: Ned hace negocios con la mafia de Springfield.

title: Carl Carlson Rides Again
subtitle: Carl descubre el origen de una misteriosa hebilla de rodeo ligada a su identidad cuando queda prendado de una bella mujer negra.

title: Bartless
subtitle: Homero y Marge imaginan un mundo en el que Bart no es un Simpson después de que su última travesura provoque el caos en la escuela primaria de Springfield.

title: Hostile Kirk Place
subtitle: Kirk emprende una cruzada para censurar y controlar el programa escolar en respuesta a una lección de historia que pinta mal a uno de sus antepasados, y Homer aparece para divertirse y sacar provecho.

title: Pin Gal
subtitle: Jacques vuelve a entrenar a Marge para un torneo de bolos.

title: Fan-ily Feud
subtitle: Homer desprecia públicamente a una cantante pop y se enfrenta a la ira de sus vengativos seguidores.

title: Write Off This Episode
subtitle: Marge se deja seducir por el dinero y el prestigio de la recaudación de fondos de Big Charity cuando ella y Lisa lanzan una organización benéfica juntas.

title: The Very Hungry Caterpillars
subtitle: Los Simpson se ven obligados a pasar tiempo juntos encerrados cuando una plaga de insectos cierra Springfield.

title: Clown v. Board of Education
subtitle: Krusty abre una escuela de payasos, que se convierte en lo más exitoso que ha hecho nunca.

title: Homer's Adventures Through the Windshield Glass
subtitle: El tiempo se detiene para Homer cuando vuela por el parabrisas tras chocar su coche y, mientras su vida pasa ante sus ojos, un amigo mágico lo ayuda a descubrir la verdad sobre su matrimonio.

title: Homer's Crossing
subtitle: Homero se ofrece como voluntario para ser guardia de cruce escolar, pero sus compañeros guardias de cruce se convierten en algo a lo que temer cuando su escuadrón de seguridad recibe demasiados fondos.

title: A Mid-Childhood Night's Dream
subtitle: Marge se siente abrumada por el miedo a que los niños crezcan.

title: McMansion & Wife
subtitle: Homer sospecha que su nuevo vecino lo colma de amabilidad para engañarlo para que compre un auto deportivo, pero la verdad es más siniestra de lo que pensaba; Lisa pone fin a la ola de acoso de Nelson.

title: Thirst Trap: A Corporate Love Story
subtitle: Una joven directora ejecutiva que ha abandonado la universidad convence al Sr. Burns para que financie el dudoso proyecto de sus sueños.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
subtitle: En el trigésimo cuarto especial anual de Halloween de los Simpson, Bart se convierte en un NFT, Lisa recurre a Sideshow Bob en busca de ayuda para localizar a un asesino en serie y un brote convierte a los Springfielders en Homers.

title: Iron Marge
subtitle: Bart y Lisa deben investigar en el pasado de Marge para demostrar que realmente la conocen cuando un mal regalo de cumpleaños le rompe el corazón. Homero se convierte en un alarmista del vecindario.

title: It's a Blunderful Life
subtitle: Lisa cuenta la historia de Homero como víctima de un apagón que sumió a Springfield en la oscuridad antes de Acción de Gracias.

title: Ae Bonny Romance
subtitle: El jardinero Willie es secuestrado y los Simpson lo siguen hasta Escocia, donde lo que les espera resulta ser la peor pesadilla de Homer.

title: Murder, She Boat
subtitle: Lisa debe resolver el "asesinato" de una figura de acción de un millón de dólares perteneciente a Comic Book Guy en un crucero de cultura pop.

title: Do the Wrong Thing
subtitle: Homer y Bart se convierten en los reyes del circuito deportivo obrero, pero Marge sospecha que hay algo deshonesto en su vínculo paterno-filial.

title: Frinkenstein's Monster
subtitle: El profesor Frink cree que ha creado un monstruo cuando ayuda a Homer a conseguir un puesto de alto nivel en una planta nuclear de última generación en Shelbyville.

title: Lisa Gets an F1
subtitle: Lisa siente una necesidad tanto de velocidad como de una forma de controlar su ansiedad cuando se convierte en una corredora profesional de karts para niños.

title: Clan of the Cave Mom
subtitle: Un desacuerdo parental entre Marge y Luann Van Houten se convierte en una lucha de vida o muerte por la supervivencia.

title: Night of the Living Wage
subtitle: Marge consigue un trabajo en una cocina fantasma llena de presión e intenta fundar un sindicato.

title: Cremains of the Day
subtitle: Homero y sus amigos de Moe emprenden un viaje por carretera para esparcir las cenizas de alguien de la vida de Homero que ha fallecido, pero su amistad también puede morir.

title: The Tell-Tale Pants
subtitle: Marge gasta secretamente una sorprendente ganancia inesperada en sí misma cuando se enfada con Homero.

title: The Tipping Point
subtitle: Homer pierde la cabeza por la cultura de la propina desbocada.

title: Bart's Brain
subtitle: Bart hace un nuevo amigo.

title: Bart's Birthday
subtitle: Bart celebra la fiesta de cumpleaños más impactante de toda su vida, una que podría cambiar a todos en Springfield para siempre.

title: The Yellow Lotus
subtitle: Los Simpson se encuentran con la muerte durante sus vacaciones en un resort de alta gama.

title: Desperately Seeking Lisa
subtitle: Lisa tiene una desventura ardiente en el oscuro mundo de la escena artística del centro de la capital.

title: Shoddy Heat
subtitle: Un cadáver desenterrado abre un caso sin resolver en Springfield en la década de 1980, así como una relación apasionante entre el joven abuelo y Agnes Skinner.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXXV
subtitle: Los monstruos de ira política aterrorizan Springfield, mientras el Sr. Burns recibe sustos de fantasmas en el Día de Acción de Gracias y Homero desarrolla una conexión única con unos jeans alienígenas.

title: Women in Shorts
subtitle: Las mujeres de Springfield aparecen en historias cortas divertidas.

title: Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
subtitle: Un hombre tatuado en un misterioso circo nocturno transporta a Lisa a tres extrañas historias de la inocente década de 1950, el escalofriante retropre

title: Convenience Airways
subtitle: Los Simpson están atrapados en un vuelo con los pasajeros más indisciplinados de Estados Unidos.

title: Homer and Her Sisters
subtitle: La tía de Krusty, que dice la verdad, arregla la relación de Homer con Patty y Selma tras una pelea en una sala de escape.

title: O C'mon All Ye Faithful
subtitle: Las cosas salen mal cuando el mentalista británico Derren Brown llega a Springfield. Homer queda hipnotizado y cree que es Santa Claus, lo que desencadena una alegre reacción en cadena en la ciudad.

title: The Man Who Flew Too Much
subtitle: Los nuevos y mejorados Pin Pals viajan a Capital City para disputar su primer campeonato estatal de bolos.

title: Bottle Episode
subtitle: Marge y Smithers se alían para convertirse en Robin Hood forjadores de vino.

title: The Past and the Furious
subtitle: Lisa retrocede en el tiempo para salvar al mini alce de Springfield de la extinción y convierte al Sr. Burns en el magnate ávido de dinero que es hoy.

title: The Flandshees of Innersimpson
subtitle: Bart entra en el mundo de los DJ famosos; Homer lleva a Flanders demasiado lejos.

title: The Last Man Expanding
subtitle: Todo el mundo en Springfield se engancha a una droga milagrosa para perder peso - excepto Homer.

title: P.S. I Hate You
subtitle: La reputación de "dama agradable" de Marge está en juego cuando un chantajista desconocido amenaza con exponer a la mujer enojada que está dentro.

title: Yellow Planet
subtitle: Los Simpson se convierten en protagonistas de un documental al estilo National Geographic, mostrando la vida cotidiana y el comportamiento humano desde una perspectiva salvaje y natural.

title: Abe League of Their Moe
subtitle: El abuelo y Moe ponen a prueba su amistad y la integridad del béisbol cuando reclutan a un bateador macedonio para jugar en Springfield.

title: Stew Lies
subtitle: Homero revitaliza la pasión perdida de un famoso chef por la comida, con la ayuda de la mafia.

title: Full Heart, Empty Pool
subtitle: Homer y el abuelo se unen para crear un nuevo deporte que rivaliza con el pickleball, hasta que Homer echa al abuelo del equipo.

title: Estranger Things
subtitle: Marge teme que Bart y Lisa se distancien cuando dejen de ver Tom y Daly juntos, pero no tiene idea de lo mal que se pondrán las cosas.

title: Thrifty Ways to Thieve Your Mother
subtitle: Lisa es bienvenida en el club de moda súper elite de la escuela cuando usa la ropa "vintage" de Marge de los años 90.

title: Keep Chalm and Gary On
subtitle: Homer le consigue al superintendente Chalmers un trabajo en la central eléctrica. Chalmers descubre enormes caracoles mutados que producen una valiosa baba, lo que inicia la nueva carrera del superintendente como gurú del hombre-esfera.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXXVI
subtitle: Un monstruo asesino del alcantarillado, un demonio en el especial de Halloween de Krusty y un futuro post-apocalíptico de plástico en Springfield.

title: Men Behaving Manly
subtitle: Por recomendación de Alexa, las mujeres de Springfield envían a los hombres y a los niños a campamentos para que aprendan a ser «masculinos» y se conviertan en los maridos, hijos y padres que ellas desean.

title: Bad Boys... For Life?
subtitle: Homer y Marge tienen que averiguar si Bart es realmente una mala semilla.

title: Bart 'N' Frink
subtitle: Bart se convierte en el asistente de laboratorio del profesor Frink, lo que lleva a los Simpson a un mundo de multimillonarios tecnológicos decididos a vivir para siempre

title: Sashes to Sashes
subtitle: Bart se presenta contra el hijo del alcalde Quimby para presidente del consejo estudiantil, mientras que Lisa descubre secretos inquietantes sobre el clan Quimby - y sobre los Simpson.

title: The Day of the Jack-up
subtitle: Lisa quiere ir a un concierto de K-pop, pero todas las entradas las compran revendedores online.

title: Aunt Misbehavin'
subtitle: Patty y Bart declaran legalmente muerto a Homer de broma, pero su alegre reacción causa una pelea entre Patty y Selma, y Patty se muda a Palm Springfield.

title: Guess Who's Coming to Skinner
subtitle: El director Skinner se convierte en tutor de un alumno fugado que vivía en la biblioteca del colegio y lo acoge en su hogar.

title: Parahormonal Activity
subtitle: Marge se enfrenta a la tormenta hormonal que azotará a sus hijos adolescentes en un futuro próximo cuando se ve afectada por un cambio en su propia vida, dejando a Homer como la única persona cuerda de la familia, al menos en apariencia.

title: ¡The Fall Guy-Yi-Yi!
subtitle: Homero se convierte en el doble secreto del Hombre Abeja para impulsar su carrera, pero el castigo físico de ser Abeja Doble resulta insoportable.

title: Seperance
subtitle: Homero consigue trabajo en una empresa secreta que pretende manipular las mentes.

title: Irrational Treasure
subtitle: La cruzada de Marge para poner a Santa's Little Helper en mejor forma resulta en un viaje al National Dog Show en Filadelfia, donde Marge y Homer se encuentran -y su perro- mezclados en una histórica aventura de conspiración.

title: Homer? A Cracker Bro?
subtitle: Homer y Kirk Van Houten lanzan un exitoso negocio de venta de galletas "sin desmoronamiento", pero Homer se ve obligado a elegir entre la familia y la fortuna cuando se revelan los secretos más oscuros de Kirk.
